examples.en: The light switch is next to the door.
examples.zh: 電燈開關就在門旁邊。

examples.en: The switch to the new system took only one weekend.
examples.zh: 改用新系統只花了一個週末。

examples.en: A sudden switch in the weather ruined our picnic plans.
examples.zh: 天氣突然轉變，打亂了我們的野餐計畫。

senses.zh: 轉換；改變；交換；開啟或關閉

examples.en: Can we switch seats so I can sit by the window?
examples.zh: 我們可以換位子嗎？我想坐在窗邊。

examples.en: She decided to switch to a healthier breakfast.
examples.zh: 她決定改吃更健康的早餐。

examples.en: Please switch off your phones before the movie starts.
examples.zh: 電影開演前，請把手機關掉。

examples.en: New technology has changed the way students study.
examples.zh: 新科技改變了學生讀書的方式。

examples.en: My uncle works for a company that develops medical technology.
examples.zh: 我叔叔任職於一家研發醫療技術的公司。

examples.en: Modern technology makes it easy to talk with friends abroad.
examples.zh: 現代科技讓我們很容易與國外的朋友聊天。

examples.en: Please read the text on page ten carefully.
examples.zh: 請仔細閱讀第十頁的課文。

examples.en: I got a text from my sister this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上收到姊姊傳來的簡訊。

examples.en: The text on the poster is too small to read.
examples.zh: 海報上的文字太小，看不清楚。

examples.en: I will text you when I arrive at the station.
examples.zh: 我到車站時會傳簡訊給你。

examples.en: Please do not text while you are driving.
examples.zh: 開車時請不要傳簡訊。

examples.en: She texted her mother to say she would be late.
examples.zh: 她傳簡訊告訴媽媽她會晚點到。

examples.en: Long walks in the sun tire me out quickly.
examples.zh: 在大太陽下走長路，我很快就累了。

examples.en: The little boy began to tire after the long hike.
examples.zh: 長途健行後，小男孩開始感到疲倦。

examples.en: I never tire of listening to her stories.
examples.zh: 我聽她說故事怎麼聽都不膩。

examples.en: My bicycle has a flat tire again.
examples.zh: 我的腳踏車輪胎又沒氣了。

examples.en: Dad bought a new tire for the family car.
examples.zh: 爸爸為家裡的車買了一個新輪胎。

examples.en: Check the air in each tire before a long trip.
examples.zh: 長途旅行前，要檢查每個輪胎的氣壓。

examples.en: Could you pass me a tissue, please?
examples.zh: 可以請你遞給我一張面紙嗎？

examples.en: Muscle tissue needs protein to grow strong.
examples.zh: 肌肉組織需要蛋白質才能長得強壯。

examples.en: She wrapped the glass cup in soft tissue paper.
examples.zh: 她用柔軟的包裝薄紙把玻璃杯包起來。

examples.en: I did not like the angry tone of his voice.
examples.zh: 我不喜歡他生氣的語氣。

examples.en: The phone made a loud tone when the call ended.
examples.zh: 通話結束時，電話發出了響亮的提示音。

examples.en: The painter used warm tones for the sunset.
examples.zh: 畫家用暖色調來畫夕陽。

examples.en: A typical school day begins at eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 一般的上學日是從八點開始。

examples.en: It was typical of him to arrive late again.
examples.zh: 他又遲到了，真是一貫的作風。

examples.en: Rice and soup make a typical Taiwanese dinner.
examples.zh: 米飯和湯是典型的台灣晚餐。

examples.en: We will go hiking unless it rains tomorrow.
examples.zh: 除非明天下雨，否則我們會去健行。

examples.en: You cannot enter the room unless you have a ticket.
examples.zh: 沒有票就不能進入這個房間。

examples.en: Don't call me unless it is really important.
examples.zh: 除非真的很重要，否則不要打電話給我。

senses.zh: 心煩的；難過的；不舒服的

examples.en: She was upset because she lost her notebook.
examples.zh: 她因為弄丟了筆記本而心煩。

examples.en: Dad has an upset stomach after the spicy dinner.
examples.zh: 吃了辛辣的晚餐後，爸爸的胃不舒服。

examples.en: Don't be upset about one bad test score.
examples.zh: 不要為了一次考不好而難過。

examples.en: The bad news upset everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 這個壞消息讓辦公室裡的每個人都很難過。

examples.en: I'm sorry if my words upset you.
examples.zh: 如果我的話讓你難過，我很抱歉。

examples.en: The heavy rain upset our travel plans.
examples.zh: 大雨打亂了我們的旅行計畫。

examples.en: The family gained great wealth from their business.
examples.zh: 這個家庭從事業中累積了龐大的財富。

examples.en: Good health is worth far more than great wealth.
examples.zh: 身體健康遠比龐大的財富更有價值。

examples.en: The library has a wealth of information about local history.
examples.zh: 這間圖書館有大量關於本地歷史的資料。

examples.en: This suitcase weighs more than twenty kilograms.
examples.zh: 這個行李箱重達二十公斤以上。

examples.en: The clerk will weigh the fruit before you pay.
examples.zh: 店員會在你付錢前先秤水果的重量。

examples.en: You should weigh the pros and cons before you decide.
examples.zh: 做決定之前，你應該先權衡利弊。

examples.en: Whenever I feel sleepy, I drink a cup of tea.
examples.zh: 每當我想睡覺時，我就喝一杯茶。

examples.en: You can visit us whenever you are free.
examples.zh: 你有空的時候隨時都可以來找我們。

examples.en: My dog barks whenever someone knocks on the door.
examples.zh: 每當有人敲門，我的狗就會叫。

senses.zh: 無論在哪裡；不管到哪裡

examples.en: You can sit wherever you like in the classroom.
examples.zh: 你可以坐在教室裡任何你喜歡的位子。

examples.en: Wherever she goes, she takes her camera with her.
examples.zh: 不管她去哪裡，都會帶著相機。

examples.en: Put the box wherever there is enough space.
examples.zh: 只要有足夠的空間，就把箱子放在那裡。

examples.en: Please whisper in the library so others can study.
examples.zh: 在圖書館請小聲說話，才不會影響別人讀書。

examples.en: She leaned over and whispered the answer to me.
examples.zh: 她靠過來，小聲地把答案告訴我。

examples.en: The children whispered quietly during the movie.
examples.zh: 孩子們在電影放映時輕聲說話。

examples.en: She spoke in a whisper so the baby would not wake up.
examples.zh: 她輕聲說話，以免吵醒寶寶。

examples.en: I heard a soft whisper behind me.
examples.zh: 我聽到身後傳來輕輕的低語聲。

examples.en: The teacher's whisper was still clear in the quiet room.
examples.zh: 在安靜的房間裡，老師的低語依然聽得很清楚。

examples.en: Whoever finishes the assignment first can leave the classroom early.
examples.zh: 不管誰先完成作業，都可以提早離開教室。

examples.en: Give this message to whoever answers the phone.
examples.zh: 請把這個訊息轉告給接電話的人。

examples.en: You can invite whoever you want to the party.
examples.zh: 你可以邀請任何你想邀請的人來參加派對。

examples.en: Don't touch the loose wire behind the television.
examples.zh: 不要碰電視後面鬆脫的電線。

examples.en: The farmer put a wire fence around the field.
examples.zh: 農夫在田地周圍圍上了鐵絲網。

examples.en: She used a thin wire to hang the picture.
examples.zh: 她用一條細鐵絲把畫掛起來。

examples.en: The workers will wire the new classroom next week.
examples.zh: 工人下週會為新教室配電線。

examples.en: He wired the two boards together to repair the fence.
examples.zh: 他用金屬線把兩塊板子綁在一起，以修理圍籬。

examples.en: They wired the house before they painted the walls.
examples.zh: 他們在粉刷牆壁之前先把屋內的電線接好。

examples.en: We ate roasted yam on a cold winter night.
examples.zh: 我們在寒冷的冬夜吃烤地瓜。

examples.en: My grandmother cooks yam soup for the whole family.
examples.zh: 奶奶為全家人煮了山藥湯。

examples.en: A yam is rich in fiber and vitamins.
examples.zh: 地瓜含有豐富的纖維和維生素。

examples.en: The class teaches the basics of computer use.
examples.zh: 這堂課教授電腦使用的基礎。

examples.en: You should learn the basics before trying hard problems.
examples.zh: 在嘗試困難的題目之前，你應該先學好基礎。

examples.en: Her father taught her the basics of swimming.
examples.zh: 她的爸爸教她游泳的基本要領。

examples.en: The school gymnasium is big enough for five hundred students.
examples.zh: 學校的體育館大到可以容納五百名學生。

examples.en: We play basketball in the gymnasium on rainy days.
examples.zh: 下雨天我們在體育館打籃球。

examples.en: The new gymnasium opens to the public next month.
examples.zh: 新的體育館下個月開放給民眾使用。

examples.en: Please enter your password to log in.
examples.zh: 請輸入你的密碼登入。

examples.en: I forgot my password, so I had to reset it.
examples.zh: 我忘記密碼了，所以只好重設。

examples.en: Choose a password that is hard to guess.
examples.zh: 請選一個不容易被猜到的密碼。

senses.zh: 多岩石的；崎嶇的；不穩定的

examples.en: The path up the mountain was steep and rocky.
examples.zh: 上山的小徑又陡又多石。

examples.en: We walked along a rocky beach at sunset.
examples.zh: 我們在日落時沿著多岩石的海灘散步。

examples.en: The company had a rocky start in its first year.
examples.zh: 這家公司創業第一年的起步並不順利。

examples.en: Many countries work together to fight terrorism.
examples.zh: 許多國家合作對抗恐怖主義。

examples.en: Our teacher explained how terrorism affects world travel.
examples.zh: 老師說明了恐怖主義如何影響世界各地的旅遊。

examples.en: The news report was about a new law against terrorism.
examples.zh: 這則新聞報導的是一項新的反恐法律。

examples.en: The airport has strict rules to stop any terrorist.
examples.zh: 機場有嚴格的規定來防範恐怖分子。

examples.en: The movie is about a police team that searches for a terrorist.
examples.zh: 這部電影講的是一個警察小組追捕恐怖分子的故事。

examples.en: The government said every terrorist would be brought to court.
examples.zh: 政府表示每一名恐怖分子都會被送上法庭。

examples.en: Please read the dialogue between Tom and Anna.
examples.zh: 請朗讀湯姆和安娜之間的對話。

examples.en: The dialogue in this movie sounds natural.
examples.zh: 這部電影的對白聽起來很自然。

examples.en: The two leaders hope to continue their dialogue next year.
examples.zh: 兩位領導人希望明年繼續進行對話。

examples.en: My little sister made a drawing of our family.
examples.zh: 我的妹妹畫了一幅我們一家人的圖。

examples.en: The art teacher hung every drawing on the wall.
examples.zh: 美術老師把每一張圖畫都掛在牆上。

examples.en: Drawing is her favorite activity after school.
examples.zh: 畫畫是她放學後最喜歡的活動。

examples.en: The fireman climbed the ladder to help the cat.
examples.zh: 消防員爬上梯子去救那隻貓。

examples.en: A fireman visited our school to talk about safety.
examples.zh: 一位消防員來到我們學校談安全。

examples.en: My brother wants to be a fireman when he grows up.
examples.zh: 我弟弟長大後想當消防員。

examples.en: The saleswoman showed us several kinds of shoes.
examples.zh: 那位女售貨員拿了好幾種鞋子給我們看。

examples.en: My aunt works as a saleswoman in a department store.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在百貨公司擔任女售貨員。

examples.en: The saleswoman gave me a discount on the jacket.
examples.zh: 女售貨員給了我那件外套折扣。

senses.zh: 實際上；其實；事實上；真的

examples.en: I thought it was easy, but it was actually quite hard.
examples.zh: 我原本以為很簡單，其實相當困難。

examples.en: Do you actually live near the train station?
examples.zh: 你真的住在火車站附近嗎？

examples.en: She is actually older than she looks.
examples.zh: 她其實比外表看起來還要年長。

examples.en: I saw an advertisement for a new bookstore on the bus.
examples.zh: 我在公車上看到一則新書店的廣告。

examples.en: The company put an advertisement in the newspaper to find workers.
examples.zh: 那家公司在報紙上刊登廣告來徵人。

examples.en: This advertisement makes the snack look delicious.
examples.zh: 這支廣告讓點心看起來很好吃。

examples.en: My cousin moved to America to study art.
examples.zh: 我表哥搬到美國去學藝術。

examples.en: Many people in America enjoy watching baseball.
examples.zh: 美國有許多人喜歡看棒球。

examples.en: Christopher Columbus sailed across the ocean and reached America.
examples.zh: 哥倫布橫渡海洋，抵達了美洲。

examples.en: She likes to listen to American pop songs.
examples.zh: 她喜歡聽美國流行歌曲。

examples.en: The American team arrived at the airport this morning.
examples.zh: 美國隊今天早上抵達機場。

examples.en: We visited an American school during our trip.
examples.zh: 我們旅行時參觀了一所美國的學校。

examples.en: My new neighbor is an American.
examples.zh: 我的新鄰居是美國人。

examples.en: Many Americans eat a big breakfast on weekends.
examples.zh: 許多美國人週末會吃豐盛的早餐。

examples.en: The Americans in our class speak a little Chinese.
examples.zh: 我們班上的美國人會說一點中文。

examples.en: Does anyone know where the teacher is?
examples.zh: 有人知道老師在哪裡嗎？

examples.en: Anyone can join the reading club after school.
examples.zh: 任何人都可以參加放學後的讀書會。

examples.en: I didn't tell anyone about the surprise party.
examples.zh: 我沒有把驚喜派對的事告訴任何人。

examples.en: My birthday is in April, two weeks after my sister's.
examples.zh: 我的生日在四月，比姊姊的生日晚兩週。

examples.en: The spring vacation starts in early April.
examples.zh: 春假從四月初開始。

examples.en: It often rains in Taipei in April.
examples.zh: 台北四月常常下雨。

examples.en: We are classmates in the same school club.
examples.zh: 我們是同一個社團的同學。

examples.en: Where are my keys? I can't find them.
examples.zh: 我的鑰匙在哪裡？我找不到。

examples.en: There are twenty students in our class.
examples.zh: 我們班上有二十位學生。

examples.en: Grandfather likes to read the newspaper in his armchair.
examples.zh: 爺爺喜歡坐在他的扶手椅上看報紙。

examples.en: We bought a soft armchair for the living room.
examples.zh: 我們為客廳買了一張柔軟的扶手椅。

examples.en: The cat is sleeping on the old armchair.
examples.zh: 貓正睡在那張舊扶手椅上。

examples.en: We usually go to the beach in August.
examples.zh: 我們八月通常會去海邊。

examples.en: The new school year begins at the end of August.
examples.zh: 新學年在八月底開始。

examples.en: It is very hot in Taiwan in August.
examples.zh: 台灣八月非常炎熱。

examples.en: The leaves turn red and yellow in autumn.
examples.zh: 樹葉在秋天會轉紅變黃。

examples.en: Autumn is a good season for hiking in the mountains.
examples.zh: 秋天是上山健行的好季節。

examples.en: We eat moon cakes during the Mid-Autumn Festival each autumn.
examples.zh: 我們每年秋天都會在中秋節吃月餅。

examples.en: The beginning of the movie was a little slow.
examples.zh: 這部電影的開頭有點慢。

examples.en: At the beginning of the year, we make new plans.
examples.zh: 年初的時候，我們會訂下新計畫。

examples.en: This small shop was the beginning of a big business.
examples.zh: 這間小店是一個大事業的起點。

examples.en: Today is my best friend's birthday, so I bought her a gift.
examples.zh: 今天是我最要好的朋友的生日，所以我買了一份禮物送她。

examples.en: We sang a song for Mom on her birthday.
examples.zh: 我們在媽媽生日那天為她唱了一首歌。

examples.en: What would you like for your birthday this year?
examples.zh: 你今年生日想要什麼禮物？

examples.en: The kids ran to the store to buy some candy.
examples.zh: 孩子們跑去商店買糖果。

examples.en: Too much candy is bad for your teeth.
examples.zh: 吃太多糖果對牙齒不好。

examples.en: The teacher gave each student a piece of candy.
examples.zh: 老師給每位學生一顆糖果。

senses.zh: 粗心的；不小心的；漫不經心的

examples.en: I made a careless mistake on the math test.
examples.zh: 我在數學考試中犯了一個粗心的錯誤。

examples.en: He was careless with his new phone and dropped it.
examples.zh: 他對新手機不夠小心，結果把它摔到地上。

examples.en: A careless driver can cause a serious accident.
examples.zh: 粗心的駕駛可能造成嚴重的意外。

examples.en: She looked at the snow with childlike joy.
examples.zh: 她帶著孩子般的喜悅看著雪。

examples.en: Grandpa still has a childlike smile on his face.
examples.zh: 爺爺臉上依然帶著天真的笑容。

examples.en: The artist's childlike pictures make many people happy.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家天真童趣的畫作讓許多人感到開心。

examples.en: Chinese New Year is a big holiday in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 農曆新年是台灣的重大節日。

examples.en: She is reading a Chinese book about history.
examples.zh: 她正在讀一本有關歷史的中文書。

examples.en: We had a Chinese dinner at my uncle's house.
examples.zh: 我們在叔叔家吃了一頓中式晚餐。

examples.en: Chinese is my first language.
examples.zh: 中文是我的母語。

examples.en: Many tourists are learning Chinese before their trip.
examples.zh: 許多遊客在旅行前會學習中文。

examples.en: The Chinese in this town celebrate the festival together.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮上的華人一起慶祝這個節日。

examples.en: We decorate a tree at home every Christmas.
examples.zh: 我們每年聖誕節都會在家裡裝飾一棵樹。

examples.en: She gave her brother a book for Christmas.
examples.zh: 她送了弟弟一本書當作聖誕禮物。

examples.en: The shopping mall is full of people before Christmas.
examples.zh: 聖誕節前，購物中心擠滿了人。

examples.en: Our classroom is on the second floor.
examples.zh: 我們的教室在二樓。

examples.en: The students cleaned the classroom after school.
examples.zh: 學生們放學後打掃教室。

examples.en: There is a big clock on the wall of the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室的牆上有一個大時鐘。

examples.en: When I was five, I could already ride a bike.
examples.zh: 我五歲的時候就已經會騎腳踏車了。

examples.en: Could you please open the window a little?
examples.zh: 可以請你把窗戶打開一點嗎？

examples.en: It could rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
examples.zh: 今天下午可能會下雨，所以帶把傘吧。

examples.en: The MRT was too crowded during rush hour.
examples.zh: 尖峰時間的捷運太擁擠了。

examples.en: We could not find a seat in the crowded restaurant.
examples.zh: 在擁擠的餐廳裡，我們找不到座位。

examples.en: Night markets are always crowded on weekends.
examples.zh: 夜市在週末總是人潮擁擠。

examples.en: Winter vacation starts in December at my cousin's school.
examples.zh: 我表弟學校的寒假從十二月開始。

examples.en: The weather is usually cold and dry here in December.
examples.zh: 這裡十二月的天氣通常寒冷乾燥。

examples.en: Our school holds a music show every December.
examples.zh: 我們學校每年十二月都會舉辦音樂表演。

examples.en: Children hunt for colored eggs at Easter.
examples.zh: 孩子們在復活節尋找彩蛋。

examples.en: Easter is a spring holiday in many countries.
examples.zh: 復活節在許多國家是春季的節日。

examples.en: Our family will visit my aunt in America for Easter.
examples.zh: 我們全家復活節要去美國拜訪阿姨。

examples.en: Four plus four makes eight, as the teacher explained.
examples.zh: 正如老師所解釋的，四加四等於八。

examples.en: The last bus to the airport leaves at eight.
examples.zh: 前往機場的末班公車八點出發。

examples.en: The number eight is considered lucky in some cultures.
examples.zh: 在某些文化中，數字八被認為很幸運。

examples.en: I have eight pencils in my bag.
examples.zh: 我的書包裡有八枝鉛筆。

examples.en: My cousin is eight years old.
examples.zh: 我的表弟八歲。

examples.en: The meeting lasted for eight hours.
examples.zh: 會議開了八個小時。

examples.en: My cousin will invite eighteen friends to his birthday party.
examples.zh: 我表哥會邀請十八位朋友參加他的生日派對。

examples.en: There are eighteen students in our English class.
examples.zh: 我們的英文課有十八個學生。

examples.en: The bus ride to the museum takes eighteen minutes.
examples.zh: 搭公車到博物館要花十八分鐘。

examples.en: At eighteen, my cousin left home to study at university.
examples.zh: 我表哥十八歲時離家去上大學。

examples.en: Nine plus nine makes eighteen, as our math teacher explained.
examples.zh: 正如數學老師所解釋的，九加九等於十八。

examples.en: The player wore number eighteen on his jersey.
examples.zh: 那位球員的球衣背號是十八號。

examples.en: My grandfather is eighty years old this year.
examples.zh: 我爺爺今年八十歲了。

examples.en: The store sells eighty kinds of tea.
examples.zh: 這家店賣八十種茶。

examples.zh: 我們開了八十公里的車才到達湖邊。

examples.zh: 對小班級來說，八十是很大的數字。

examples.en: She lived to be nearly eighty and stayed active throughout her life.
examples.zh: 她活到將近八十歲，一生都保持活躍。

examples.zh: 如黑板上所示，十乘以八等於八十。

examples.zh: 我們需要十一張星期五晚上的電影票。

examples.zh: 我們的足球隊場上有十一名球員。

examples.en: My little brother is eleven years old.
examples.zh: 我弟弟十一歲。

examples.zh: 在我們班上，十一號緊接在十號之後。

examples.zh: 會議在十一點結束，正好在我們午休之前。

examples.en: Tom wears number eleven on his back.
examples.zh: 湯姆背上穿的是十一號球衣。

examples.en: She speaks English very well and often helps foreign visitors.
examples.zh: 她的英語說得很好，經常幫助外國遊客。

examples.zh: 英文是我在學校最喜歡的科目。

examples.zh: 她為了期末考念了一整晚的書。

examples.zh: 我的生日在二月，比姊姊的生日晚兩週。

examples.zh: 二月的台北仍然很冷。

examples.zh: 她在市場買了十五顆蘋果。

examples.zh: 我阿姨五十歲，職業是護理師。

examples.zh: 她為新學期買了五本筆記本。

examples.zh: 教室裡有四十張課桌。

examples.zh: 我叔叔四十歲，在銀行工作。

examples.zh: 這班公車要四十分鐘才到市區。

examples.zh: 我媽媽剛滿四十歲，並和朋友們一起慶祝。

examples.zh: 我們的火車十分鐘後抵達四十號月台。

examples.zh: 我們午餐點了四碗麵。

examples.zh: 四和六、八一樣，都是偶數。

examples.zh: 這家店星期日四點打烊。

examples.zh: 在你名字旁邊的方框裡寫一個四。

examples.zh: 我表妹十四歲，很喜歡打籃球。

examples.zh: 兩週有十四天。

examples.zh: 學校圖書館有十四台電腦供學生使用。

examples.zh: 十四是介於十三和十五之間的偶數。

examples.zh: 這班公車從十四號乘車處出發。

examples.zh: 未滿十四歲的女孩可以加入青少年隊。

examples.zh: 我們每個星期五早上都有小考。

examples.zh: 我忘了把飛盤帶去海邊。

examples.zh: 氧氣是我們呼吸所需的一種氣體。

examples.zh: 離開廚房前請把瓦斯關掉。

examples.zh: 我們在前往花蓮的路上停下來加油。

examples.zh: 我奶奶的第一個孫女出生在五月。

examples.zh: 他們的孫子住在別的城市，每週都會打電話給他們。

examples.zh: 那位老太太煮湯給她的孫子喝。

examples.zh: 他們在體育館舉行畢業典禮。

examples.zh: 孩子們在萬聖節會穿上各種裝扮，向鄰居要糖果。

examples.zh: 我們班為萬聖節辦了一場小派對。

examples.zh: 萬聖節每年都在十月三十一日。

examples.zh: 這把傘不是我的，是她的。

examples.zh: 我的房間比她的大，但她的房間有陽台。

examples.zh: 她揮揮手，向鄰居打招呼。

examples.zh: 他把他的雨傘忘在公車上了。

examples.zh: 那輛紅色腳踏車是他的，藍色那輛是我的。

examples.zh: 我媽媽是醫院的護理師。

examples.zh: 去年一月幾乎天天下雨。

examples.zh: 我們每年七月都會去海邊。

examples.zh: 我姊姊六月要從高中畢業了。

examples.zh: 學校的運動會在六月的第一個星期六舉行。

examples.zh: 數學是我在學校最喜歡的科目。

examples.zh: 我們的數學老師把難題講解得很清楚。

examples.zh: 我每個星期一下午都要上鋼琴課。

examples.zh: 星期一是一週中的第一個上課日。

examples.zh: 寶寶逗趣的動作讓房間裡的每個人都笑了。

examples.zh: 緩慢的動作讓舞者保持平衡。

examples.zh: 這場學生運動是從大學裡開始的。

examples.zh: 我們每天早上搭捷運上學。

examples.zh: 捷運站離我家走路只要五分鐘。

examples.zh: 尖峰時段，捷運比公車快。

examples.zh: 你比較喜歡哪一個，紅色的包包還是藍色的？

examples.en: One should always be polite to guests.
examples.zh: 對客人應該永遠保持禮貌。

examples.en: Our teacher gave us a lot of homework.
examples.zh: 我們的老師給了我們很多作業。

examples.en: We painted our classroom door green during the summer vacation.
examples.zh: 我們在暑假期間把教室的門漆成綠色。

examples.en: This is our first trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 這是我們第一次去日本旅行。

examples.en: This table is ours; the other one is theirs.
examples.zh: 這張桌子是我們的，另一張是他們的。

examples.en: Your house is bigger than ours and has a larger garden.
examples.zh: 你們的房子比我們的大，花園也比較大。

examples.en: The blue bus is ours, so please get on.
examples.zh: 那輛藍色的公車是我們的，請上車。

examples.en: Students cross the road by using the overpass.
examples.zh: 學生們利用天橋過馬路。

examples.en: There is a long overpass near our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校附近有一座很長的天橋。

examples.en: The bus drove under the overpass on its way downtown.
examples.zh: 公車往市區行駛途中從高架橋下方駛過。

examples.en: We have PE on Tuesday and Thursday mornings.
examples.zh: 我們星期二和星期四早上有體育課。

examples.en: Our PE teacher taught us how to play badminton.
examples.zh: 我們的體育老師教我們怎麼打羽毛球。

examples.en: I forgot to bring my PE clothes to school.
examples.zh: 我忘了把體育課的衣服帶到學校。

examples.en: She put a family photo on her desk.
examples.zh: 她在書桌上放了一張全家福照片。

examples.en: Can you take a photo of us here?
examples.zh: 你可以在這裡幫我們拍張照嗎？

examples.en: The photo on the wall shows my grandfather's old house.
examples.zh: 牆上的照片是我爺爺的老房子。

examples.en: My parents were pleased with my test results.
examples.zh: 我父母對我的考試成績很滿意。

examples.en: I am pleased to meet you and welcome you to our team.
examples.zh: 很高興認識您，也歡迎您加入我們的團隊。

examples.en: The manager looked pleased with the new design.
examples.zh: 經理看起來對新設計很滿意。

examples.en: The little princess lived in a tall castle by the sea.
examples.zh: 小公主住在海邊一座高大的城堡裡。

examples.en: My niece wants to dress up as a princess for Halloween.
examples.zh: 我姪女萬聖節想打扮成公主。

examples.en: The princess in the story learned to be kind and brave.
examples.zh: 故事裡的公主學會了善良與勇敢。

examples.en: We usually go to the night market on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們星期六通常會去逛夜市。

examples.en: Saturday is the busiest day at our restaurant.
examples.zh: 星期六是我們餐廳最忙的一天。

examples.en: The school sports day will be held next Saturday.
examples.zh: 學校運動會將在下星期六舉行。

examples.en: School starts again in September after the long summer vacation.
examples.zh: 漫長的暑假過後，學校在九月重新開學。

examples.en: My birthday is on the tenth of September.
examples.zh: 我的生日是九月十日。

examples.en: September is still warm in southern Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣南部，九月還是很溫暖。

examples.en: There are seven days in a week.
examples.zh: 一週有七天。

examples.en: My little brother reads seven pages before going to bed.
examples.zh: 我弟弟睡前會讀七頁書。

examples.en: We bought seven tickets for the concert.
examples.zh: 我們買了七張音樂會的票。

examples.en: Seven is my lucky number, so I chose it for my jersey.
examples.zh: 七是我的幸運數字，所以我選它作為球衣背號。

examples.en: Three plus four makes seven, as the teacher explained.
examples.zh: 正如老師所解釋的，三加四等於七。

examples.en: The movie starts at seven, so let's have dinner first.
examples.zh: 電影七點開始，所以我們先吃晚餐吧。

examples.en: My sister invited seventeen classmates to her birthday party.
examples.zh: 我姊姊邀請了十七位同學參加她的生日派對。

examples.en: The class trip costs seventeen hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 這次班級旅行要花一千七百元。

examples.en: Seventeen students joined the English club to practice speaking together.
examples.zh: 十七位學生加入了英語社，一起練習口說。

examples.en: Seventeen is a prime number between thirteen and nineteen.
examples.zh: 十七是介於十三和十九之間的質數。

examples.en: She won the prize at seventeen after years of practice.
examples.zh: 經過多年的練習，她十七歲時贏得了這個獎。

examples.en: Please write seventeen in the box next to your name.
examples.zh: 請在你名字旁邊的方框裡寫上十七。

examples.en: My grandmother is seventy years old and enjoys working in her garden.
examples.zh: 我奶奶七十歲了，很喜歡整理自己的花園。

examples.en: The bus can carry seventy passengers, including those who are standing.
examples.zh: 這輛公車連同站立的乘客在內，可以載七十人。

examples.en: We walked seventy meters to the station.
examples.zh: 我們走了七十公尺到車站。

examples.en: Seventy is the number of questions on our final exam.
examples.zh: 我們的期末考共有七十題。

examples.en: My neighbor is in his seventies, but he still jogs.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居七十多歲了，但仍然慢跑。

examples.en: Seven times ten is seventy, as shown on the board.
examples.zh: 如黑板上所示，七乘以十等於七十。

examples.en: You should drink more water every day.
examples.zh: 你應該每天多喝水。

examples.en: Students should hand in their homework on time.
examples.zh: 學生應該準時交作業。

examples.en: The package should arrive by Friday if there are no delays.
examples.zh: 如果沒有延誤，包裹照理說最晚會在星期五送到。

examples.en: There are six eggs in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡有六顆蛋。

examples.en: My sister has six pairs of shoes.
examples.zh: 我姊姊有六雙鞋子。

examples.en: We waited for six minutes in the rain.
examples.zh: 我們在雨中等了六分鐘。

examples.en: Six is half of twelve, as our math teacher explained.
examples.zh: 正如數學老師所解釋的，六是十二的一半。

examples.en: Our class ends at six, just before the library closes.
examples.zh: 我們的課六點結束，正好在圖書館關門之前。

examples.en: Write a six in the box next to your name.
examples.zh: 在你名字旁邊的方框裡寫一個六。

examples.en: Sixteen teams entered the basketball tournament held at our school.
examples.zh: 十六支隊伍參加了在我們學校舉辦的籃球比賽。

examples.en: The room has sixteen desks and a large board.
examples.zh: 這間教室有十六張書桌和一塊大黑板。

examples.en: I saved sixteen dollars for the new notebook.
examples.zh: 我存了十六元要買新的筆記本。

examples.en: Sixteen is the square of four, as the teacher explained.
examples.zh: 正如老師所解釋的，十六是四的平方。

examples.en: She learned to drive at sixteen with help from her father.
examples.zh: 她在父親的幫助下，十六歲時學會了開車。

examples.en: The number sixteen is printed on the front of her jersey.
examples.zh: 她球衣正面印的背號是十六號。

examples.en: The store is sixty meters from my house.
examples.zh: 那家店離我家六十公尺。

examples.en: Sixty students attended the school meeting in the main hall.
examples.zh: 六十位學生出席了在大禮堂舉行的學校會議。

examples.en: It takes about sixty minutes to cook the soup.
examples.zh: 煮這鍋湯大約要花六十分鐘。

examples.en: Sixty is a round number that is easy to remember.
examples.zh: 六十是容易記住的整十數。

examples.en: My uncle retired at sixty and moved to the countryside.
examples.zh: 我叔叔六十歲退休後搬到鄉下。

examples.en: Six times ten is sixty, as our math teacher explained.
examples.zh: 正如數學老師所解釋的，六乘以十等於六十。

examples.en: We took the subway to the museum in London.
examples.zh: 我們搭地鐵去倫敦的博物館。

examples.en: The subway was crowded during rush hour.
examples.zh: 尖峰時段的地鐵非常擁擠。

examples.en: A subway runs under the busy street so people can cross safely.
examples.zh: 一條地下道穿過繁忙的街道，讓行人能安全通行。

examples.en: We go swimming almost every day in summer.
examples.zh: 我們夏天幾乎天天去游泳。

examples.en: The summer vacation lasts for two months.
examples.zh: 暑假長達兩個月。

examples.en: Summer in Taiwan is hot and humid.
examples.zh: 台灣的夏天又熱又潮濕。

examples.en: My family goes to the park on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 我們一家人星期日早上會去公園。

examples.en: Sunday is the only day my father can sleep in.
examples.zh: 星期日是我爸爸唯一能睡懶覺的日子。

examples.en: The shop is closed on Sunday to give the staff a rest.
examples.zh: 這家店星期日公休，讓員工休息。

examples.en: Taiwan is famous for its night markets and friendly people.
examples.zh: 台灣以夜市和親切的人民聞名。

examples.en: Many tourists visit Taiwan in the spring.
examples.zh: 許多觀光客在春天造訪台灣。

examples.en: My grandparents have lived in Taiwan all their lives.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母一輩子都住在台灣。

examples.en: We took a taxi to the airport because we were late.
examples.zh: 我們因為快遲到了，所以搭計程車去機場。

examples.en: The taxi driver knew a shortcut to the hotel.
examples.zh: 計程車司機知道一條到飯店的捷徑。

examples.en: Can you call a taxi for us, please?
examples.zh: 可以請你幫我們叫一輛計程車嗎？

examples.en: There are ten students in the music room.
examples.zh: 音樂教室裡有十位學生。

examples.en: I waited for ten minutes at the bus stop.
examples.zh: 我在公車站等了十分鐘。

examples.en: She has ten fingers and ten toes.
examples.zh: 她有十根手指和十根腳趾。

examples.en: Ten is the number after nine on this classroom chart.
examples.zh: 在這張教室裡的表上，十是九後面的數字。

examples.en: The meeting starts at ten in the main conference room.
examples.zh: 會議十點在主要會議室開始。

examples.en: Five plus five equals ten, as shown on the board.
examples.zh: 如黑板上所示，五加五等於十。

examples.en: The students left their bags in the classroom.
examples.zh: 學生們把書包留在教室裡。

examples.en: My neighbors painted their house blue last year.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居去年把他們的房子漆成藍色。

examples.en: The birds built their nest in the old tree.
examples.zh: 鳥兒們在老樹上築了牠們的巢。

examples.en: My brother is thirteen years old and attends junior high school.
examples.zh: 我弟弟十三歲，目前就讀國中。

examples.en: There are thirteen books on the shelf.
examples.zh: 書架上有十三本書。

examples.en: Thirteen students signed up for the art class.
examples.zh: 有十三位學生報名了美術課。

examples.en: Thirteen is often seen as an unlucky number.
examples.zh: 十三常被視為不吉利的數字。

examples.en: He started learning piano at thirteen with a teacher from Taipei.
examples.zh: 他十三歲時開始跟一位來自台北的老師學鋼琴。

examples.en: Please write thirteen in the box next to your name.
examples.zh: 請在你名字旁邊的方框裡寫上十三。

examples.en: The test lasts thirty minutes, so please manage your time carefully.
examples.zh: 這場考試為時三十分鐘，請妥善分配時間。

examples.en: Thirty people came to the school concert.
examples.zh: 有三十個人來看學校的音樂會。

examples.en: Our teacher has thirty students in her class.
examples.zh: 我們老師班上有三十位學生。

examples.en: Thirty is three times ten, as our math teacher explained.
examples.zh: 正如數學老師所解釋的，三十是十的三倍。

examples.en: My aunt started her own shop at thirty.
examples.zh: 我阿姨三十歲時開了自己的店。

examples.en: She scored thirty on the test and decided to study harder.
examples.zh: 她考試得了三十分，決定更加用功。

examples.en: I have three brothers and one sister.
examples.zh: 我有三個哥哥和一個姊姊。

examples.en: Add three spoons of sugar to the milk.
examples.zh: 在牛奶裡加三匙糖。

examples.en: The train leaves in three minutes, so we should hurry.
examples.zh: 火車三分鐘後出發，所以我們得趕快。

examples.en: Three is an odd number, just like five and seven.
examples.zh: 三和五、七一樣，都是奇數。

examples.en: School ends at three on Fridays because there are fewer classes.
examples.zh: 星期五因為課比較少，學校三點就放學。

examples.en: Write a three in the box next to your name.
examples.zh: 在你名字旁邊的方框裡寫一個三。

examples.en: We have a math quiz on Thursday.
examples.zh: 我們星期四有數學小考。

examples.en: My mother goes to yoga class every Thursday evening.
examples.zh: 我媽媽每週四晚上都去上瑜伽課。

examples.en: The library closes early on Thursday for a staff meeting.
examples.zh: 圖書館星期四因員工會議而提早關門。

examples.en: These trousers are too long for me.
examples.zh: 這條長褲對我來說太長了。

examples.en: He wore black trousers and a white shirt to school.
examples.zh: 他穿黑色長褲和白襯衫去上學。

examples.en: I need to buy a new pair of trousers for work.
examples.zh: 我需要買一條新的工作長褲。

examples.en: Our English class meets on Tuesday and Thursday.
examples.zh: 我們的英文課在星期二和星期四上。

examples.en: I have a dentist appointment next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 我下星期二要看牙醫。

examples.en: Tuesday was the first day of the new term.
examples.zh: 星期二是新學期的第一天。

examples.en: We had roast turkey for dinner on Thanksgiving.
examples.zh: 我們在感恩節晚餐吃了烤火雞。

examples.en: A wild turkey walked across the farm road.
examples.zh: 一隻野生火雞走過農場的小路。

examples.en: Turkey has many beautiful beaches and old cities.
examples.zh: 土耳其有許多美麗的海灘和古城。

examples.en: There are twelve months in a year.
examples.zh: 一年有十二個月。

examples.en: She bought twelve eggs at the market.
examples.zh: 她在市場買了十二顆蛋。

examples.en: My cousin is twelve years old and enjoys playing tennis.
examples.zh: 我表妹十二歲，很喜歡打網球。

examples.en: Twelve is divisible by three, as we learned in math class.
examples.zh: 正如我們在數學課上所學的，十二可以被三整除。

examples.en: Lunch break begins at twelve and lasts for one hour.
examples.zh: 午休十二點開始，為時一小時。

examples.en: Please write twelve in the box next to your name.
examples.zh: 請在你名字旁邊的方框裡寫上十二。

examples.en: The bus ride takes about twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 搭公車大約要二十分鐘。

examples.en: Twenty students joined the summer camp to practice speaking English.
examples.zh: 二十位學生參加了夏令營，練習英語口說。

examples.en: I paid twenty dollars for this notebook.
examples.zh: 我花了二十元買這本筆記本。

examples.en: Twenty is twice as many as ten.
examples.zh: 二十是十的兩倍。

examples.en: She became a teacher at twenty after completing her training.
examples.zh: 她完成培訓後，在二十歲時成為老師。

examples.en: The number twenty is printed on the back of his jersey.
examples.zh: 他球衣背面印的背號是二十號。

examples.en: I bought two tickets for the movie.
examples.zh: 我買了兩張電影票。

examples.en: There are two cats sleeping on the sofa.
examples.zh: 有兩隻貓在沙發上睡覺。

examples.en: She has two brothers and no sisters.
examples.zh: 她有兩個哥哥，沒有姊妹。

examples.en: Two is the smallest prime number and the only even prime.
examples.zh: 二是最小的質數，也是唯一的偶質數。

examples.en: The class ends at two, just before the school concert.
examples.zh: 課在兩點結束，正好在學校音樂會開始之前。

examples.en: One plus one is two, as the teacher explained.
examples.zh: 正如老師所解釋的，一加一等於二。

examples.en: The USA has fifty states and a large population.
examples.zh: 美國有五十州，人口眾多。

examples.en: My uncle has lived in the USA for ten years.
examples.zh: 我叔叔已經在美國住了十年。

examples.en: Many students from Taiwan study in the USA after high school.
examples.zh: 許多台灣學生高中畢業後到美國念書。

examples.en: The waitress brought us two cups of tea.
examples.zh: 女服務生為我們送來兩杯茶。

examples.en: My sister works as a waitress on weekends.
examples.zh: 我姊姊週末當女服務生。

examples.en: The waitress smiled and asked what we would like to eat.
examples.zh: 女服務生微笑著問我們想吃什麼。

examples.en: We have swimming class on Wednesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們星期三下午有游泳課。

examples.en: Wednesday is the middle of the school week.
examples.zh: 星期三是上課週的中間。

examples.en: The meeting was moved to next Wednesday.
examples.zh: 會議改到下星期三。

examples.en: The winner of the speech contest got a gold medal.
examples.zh: 演講比賽的優勝者獲得了一面金牌。

examples.en: Our class was the winner of the cleaning contest.
examples.zh: 我們班是整潔比賽的贏家。

examples.en: Everyone clapped for the winner of the race.
examples.zh: 大家為賽跑的冠軍鼓掌。

examples.en: It snows a lot in northern Japan in winter.
examples.zh: 日本北部冬天常下雪。

examples.en: I wear a thick coat every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天我都穿厚外套。

examples.en: The winter vacation begins in late January.
examples.zh: 寒假從一月底開始。

examples.en: Many birds winter in warmer parts of Asia.
examples.zh: 許多鳥類在亞洲較溫暖的地區過冬。

examples.en: The family winters in the south to avoid the cold.
examples.zh: 這家人到南部過冬以躲避寒冷。

examples.en: These geese winter by the lake every year.
examples.zh: 這些鵝每年都在湖邊過冬。

examples.en: My father cooked fried rice in a large wok.
examples.zh: 我爸爸用一個大炒鍋炒飯。

examples.en: Heat the oil in the wok before adding the vegetables.
examples.zh: 加入蔬菜前，先在炒鍋裡把油燒熱。

examples.en: This wok is perfect for stir-frying noodles.
examples.zh: 這個炒鍋很適合炒麵。

examples.en: This pen is mine, and that one is yours.
examples.zh: 這支筆是我的，那支是你的。

examples.en: Our classroom is bigger than yours and has more windows.
examples.zh: 我們的教室比你們的大，窗戶也比較多。

examples.en: Is this umbrella yours or hers, or does it belong to someone else?
examples.zh: 這把傘是你的、她的，還是別人的？

examples.en: Please help yourself to some cake while I make tea.
examples.zh: 我泡茶的時候，請自己拿些蛋糕吃。

examples.en: You should be proud of yourself for finishing the project.
examples.zh: 你完成了這個專案，應該為自己感到驕傲。

examples.en: Did you make this scarf yourself, or did someone help you?
examples.zh: 這條圍巾是你自己做的，還是有人幫你？

examples.en: The cake your mother made was really yummy.
examples.zh: 你媽媽做的蛋糕真的很好吃。

examples.en: These yummy cookies are still warm from the oven.
examples.zh: 這些好吃的餅乾剛出爐還是熱的。

examples.en: The soup that my grandmother cooked smells yummy.
examples.zh: 我奶奶煮的湯聞起來好香。

examples.en: I don't live in that town anymore.
examples.zh: 我不再住在那個小鎮了。

examples.en: The shop doesn't sell paper cups anymore.
examples.zh: 那家店不再賣紙杯了。

examples.en: She doesn't play the piano anymore because she hurt her hand.
examples.zh: 她因為手受傷，不再彈鋼琴了。

examples.en: Asia is the largest continent in the world.
examples.zh: 亞洲是世界上最大的洲。

examples.en: We plan to travel around Asia next summer.
examples.zh: 我們打算明年夏天到亞洲各地旅行。

examples.en: Rice is an important food in many parts of Asia.
examples.zh: 米飯在亞洲許多地方是重要的食物。

examples.en: Our school has an Asian food festival every year.
examples.zh: 我們學校每年都舉辦亞洲美食節。

examples.en: She studies Asian history at university and hopes to become a teacher.
examples.zh: 她在大學研讀亞洲歷史，希望成為老師。

examples.en: The Asian Games bring athletes from many countries together.
examples.zh: 亞洲運動會讓來自許多國家的運動員齊聚一堂。

examples.en: Many Asians celebrate the Lunar New Year with their families.
examples.zh: 許多亞洲人與家人一起慶祝農曆新年。

examples.en: The class welcomed a new student, an Asian from Korea.
examples.zh: 班上迎接了一位新同學，是來自韓國的亞洲人。

examples.en: An Asian won the first prize in the piano contest.
examples.zh: 一位亞洲人在鋼琴比賽中拿下首獎。

examples.en: Australia is famous for kangaroos and beautiful beaches.
examples.zh: 澳洲以袋鼠和美麗的海灘聞名。

examples.en: My uncle moved to Australia five years ago.
examples.zh: 我叔叔五年前搬到澳洲。

examples.en: It is summer in Australia when it is winter in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣是冬天的時候，澳洲是夏天。

senses.zh: 當臨時保母；臨時照顧小孩

examples.en: I babysit my neighbor's children on Saturday nights.
examples.zh: 我星期六晚上幫鄰居照顧小孩。

examples.en: Could you babysit for us this evening?
examples.zh: 你今晚可以幫我們照顧小孩嗎？

examples.en: She likes to babysit because she loves little kids.
examples.zh: 她喜歡當臨時保母，因為她很愛小孩。

examples.en: The babysitter read a story to the children.
examples.zh: 保母唸了一個故事給孩子們聽。

examples.en: We hired a babysitter for the evening.
examples.zh: 我們請了一位臨時保母，晚上幫忙照顧孩子。

examples.en: My cousin works as a babysitter after school.
examples.zh: 我表姊放學後當臨時保母。

examples.en: Britain has many old castles and famous museums.
examples.zh: 英國有許多古堡和著名的博物館。

examples.en: My teacher spent two years studying in Britain.
examples.zh: 我的老師在英國念了兩年書。

examples.en: Tea is a popular drink in Britain.
examples.zh: 茶在英國是很受歡迎的飲料。

examples.en: The businessperson flew to Tokyo for an important meeting.
examples.zh: 那位商人搭飛機到東京開重要會議。

examples.en: A good businessperson listens carefully to customers.
examples.zh: 好的商人會仔細傾聽顧客的意見。

examples.en: My aunt is a successful businessperson who owns three shops.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是成功的商人，擁有三家店。

examples.en: We met at a small cafe near the station.
examples.zh: 我們在車站附近的一家小咖啡館碰面。

examples.en: The cafe opens at eight and serves breakfast.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡館八點開門，供應早餐。

examples.en: She studies at the cafe after school.
examples.zh: 她放學後在咖啡館讀書。

examples.en: Canada is a large country with many lakes and forests.
examples.zh: 加拿大是一個擁有許多湖泊和森林的大國。

examples.en: My cousin studies at a university in Canada.
examples.zh: 我表哥在加拿大的一所大學就讀。

examples.en: It is very cold in Canada during winter.
examples.zh: 加拿大的冬天非常寒冷。

examples.en: I bought a new CD of my favorite singer.
examples.zh: 我買了一張我最喜歡的歌手的新專輯。

examples.en: Please put the CD into the player.
examples.zh: 請把光碟放進播放機。

examples.en: My father keeps his old CDs in a box under the bed.
examples.zh: 我爸爸把舊光碟收在床底下的箱子裡。

examples.en: Certainly, you can borrow my dictionary until the end of class.
examples.zh: 當然可以，你可以借用我的字典直到下課。

examples.en: This is certainly the best pizza in town.
examples.zh: 這肯定是鎮上最好吃的披薩。

examples.en: She will certainly pass the test if she keeps studying.
examples.zh: 如果她持續讀書，一定會通過考試。

examples.en: The chairperson opened the meeting at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 主席在九點整宣布開會。

examples.en: Our class elected a new chairperson for the student club.
examples.zh: 我們班為學生社團選出了新的主席。

examples.en: The chairperson asked everyone to share their ideas.
examples.zh: 主席請大家分享各自的想法。

examples.en: I ordered a burger and a large coke.
examples.zh: 我點了一個漢堡和一杯大杯可樂。

examples.en: He poured a cold coke into the glass.
examples.zh: 他把冰可樂倒進杯子裡。

examples.en: Would you like a coke or some juice?
examples.zh: 你想喝可樂還是果汁？

examples.en: Confucius was a famous teacher in ancient China.
examples.zh: 孔子是中國古代一位著名的老師。

examples.en: We learned about Confucius in our history class.
examples.zh: 我們在歷史課上學習了與孔子有關的知識。

examples.en: Many people in Taiwan visit the temple of Confucius every year.
examples.zh: 每年都有許多台灣人參訪孔廟。

examples.en: My dad cooks dinner for us every Sunday.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每個星期天都會煮晚餐給我們吃。

examples.en: Dad, can you drive me to school this morning?
examples.zh: 爸，你今天早上可以載我去學校嗎？

examples.en: She asked her dad to help her fix the bicycle.
examples.zh: 她請爸爸幫她修理腳踏車。

examples.en: England is famous for its rainy weather and old castles.
examples.zh: 英格蘭以多雨的天氣和古老的城堡聞名。

examples.en: My cousin is studying business in England.
examples.zh: 我的表哥正在英格蘭念商學。

examples.en: We will fly to England for our summer trip.
examples.zh: 我們暑假旅行要搭飛機去英格蘭。

examples.en: Europe has many countries that are close to each other.
examples.zh: 歐洲有許多彼此距離相近的國家。

examples.en: They traveled around Europe by train last summer.
examples.zh: 他們去年夏天搭火車在歐洲各地旅行。

examples.en: Her aunt has lived in Europe for over ten years.
examples.zh: 她的阿姨已經在歐洲住了十多年。

examples.en: She enjoys European history and art and often visits museums.
examples.zh: 她喜歡歐洲的歷史與藝術，經常參觀博物館。

examples.en: This restaurant serves traditional European food made with fresh local ingredients.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應以新鮮當地食材製作的傳統歐洲料理。

examples.en: The European team won the match easily.
examples.zh: 歐洲隊輕鬆贏得了比賽。

examples.en: A European sat next to me on the plane.
examples.zh: 有一位歐洲人坐在我旁邊的飛機座位上。

examples.en: Many Europeans enjoy riding bicycles to work.
examples.zh: 許多歐洲人喜歡騎腳踏車上班。

examples.en: The tour guide is a friendly European.
examples.zh: 這位導遊是個親切的歐洲人。

examples.en: Everybody in our class passed the English test.
examples.zh: 我們班上每個人都通過了英文考試。

examples.en: Is everybody ready to leave for the museum?
examples.zh: 大家都準備好要出發去博物館了嗎？

examples.en: Everybody likes the new teacher because she is so kind.
examples.zh: 大家都喜歡這位新老師，因為她很親切。

examples.en: France is well known for its bread and cheese.
examples.zh: 法國以麵包和起司聞名。

examples.en: We plan to visit France during the winter vacation.
examples.zh: 我們打算在寒假去法國玩。

examples.en: My teacher was born in France but works in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我的老師出生在法國，但在台北工作。

examples.en: Germany is known for making cars sold around the world.
examples.zh: 德國以製造銷往世界各地的汽車聞名。

examples.en: My brother is studying engineering in Germany.
examples.zh: 我哥哥正在德國念工程。

examples.en: We flew from Taipei to Germany last month.
examples.zh: 我們上個月從台北搭機前往德國。

examples.en: He is a good-looking boy with a warm smile.
examples.zh: 他是個長得好看的男孩，笑容很溫暖。

examples.en: The actress is very good-looking and kind to fans.
examples.zh: 這位女演員非常漂亮，而且對粉絲很親切。

examples.en: They bought a good-looking sofa for the living room.
examples.zh: 他們為客廳買了一張好看的沙發。

examples.en: I saw her at the library yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我昨天下午在圖書館看到她。

examples.en: Please give her the keys before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請把鑰匙交給她。

examples.en: The teacher asked her to read the story aloud.
examples.zh: 老師請她把故事朗讀出來。

examples.en: Her bag is under the desk next to the window.
examples.zh: 她的書包在窗邊的書桌底下。

examples.en: Mina forgot her umbrella on the bus.
examples.zh: 米娜把雨傘忘在公車上了。

examples.en: Her new teacher is very friendly and answers questions patiently.
examples.zh: 她的新老師非常友善，會耐心回答問題。

examples.en: The heroine in the movie saves her village.
examples.zh: 電影裡的女主角拯救了她的村莊。

examples.en: Many children see the nurse as a heroine.
examples.zh: 許多孩子把那位護理師視為女英雄。

examples.en: The heroine of the novel is a brave young girl.
examples.zh: 這本小說的女主角是個勇敢的年輕女孩。

examples.en: Mary bought herself a new notebook for her science class.
examples.zh: 瑪莉為了上自然課，幫自己買了一本新筆記本。

examples.en: She made the cake by herself for her mother's birthday.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕是她為媽媽生日獨自做的。

examples.en: The girl looked at herself in the mirror.
examples.zh: 女孩看著鏡子裡的自己。

examples.en: Please tell him to call me back.
examples.zh: 請告訴他回電話給我。

examples.en: We gave him a gift for his birthday.
examples.zh: 我們送了他一份生日禮物。

examples.en: I met him at the station this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上在車站遇到他。

examples.en: Tom taught himself how to play the guitar.
examples.zh: 湯姆自己學會了彈吉他。

examples.en: He cut himself while cooking dinner and put on a bandage.
examples.zh: 他煮晚餐時割傷了自己，並用繃帶包紮。

examples.en: The boy dressed himself for school without any help from his parents.
examples.zh: 這個男孩沒讓父母幫忙，自己穿好衣服去上學。

senses.zh: 女主人；女接待員；女主持人

examples.en: The hostess welcomed every guest at the door.
examples.zh: 女主人在門口歡迎每一位客人。

examples.en: A hostess led us to a table by the window.
examples.zh: 一位女接待員帶我們到靠窗的座位。

examples.en: The hostess of the show asked the guests a few questions.
examples.zh: 節目的女主持人問了來賓幾個問題。

examples.en: Hualien is famous for its beautiful mountains and coast.
examples.zh: 花蓮以美麗的山脈和海岸聞名。

examples.en: We took a train to Hualien during the long weekend.
examples.zh: 我們利用連假搭火車去了花蓮。

examples.en: My grandparents live in a small town near Hualien.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母住在花蓮附近的小鎮。

examples.en: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
examples.zh: 我回到家時，小狗搖了搖牠的尾巴。

examples.en: This phone is nice, but its battery is weak.
examples.zh: 這支手機不錯，但它的電池不耐用。

examples.en: The company changed its name last year.
examples.zh: 那家公司去年更改了它的名稱。

examples.en: The cat cleaned itself with its tongue.
examples.zh: 貓用舌頭把自己舔乾淨。

examples.en: The door closed by itself when a strong wind blew.
examples.zh: 一陣強風吹來時，門自己關上了。

examples.en: The museum itself is more interesting than the gift shop.
examples.zh: 博物館本身比禮品店有趣多了。

examples.en: Japan is only a few hours away from Taiwan by plane.
examples.zh: 從台灣搭飛機到日本只要幾個小時。

examples.en: We ate delicious sushi when we visited Japan.
examples.zh: 我們去日本時吃了很好吃的壽司。

examples.en: Her family moved to Japan for her father's job.
examples.zh: 她的家人因為爸爸的工作搬到了日本。

examples.en: I bought a Japanese dictionary at the bookstore.
examples.zh: 我在書店買了一本日語字典。

examples.en: They had a Japanese breakfast at the hotel.
examples.zh: 他們在飯店吃了日式早餐。

examples.en: She is learning Japanese music at school.
examples.zh: 她在學校學習日本音樂。

examples.en: My cousin can speak Japanese very well.
examples.zh: 我的表姊日語說得很好。

examples.en: The Japanese in our tour group were very polite.
examples.zh: 我們旅行團裡的日本人都很有禮貌。

examples.en: Japanese is not easy, but I like it.
examples.zh: 日語不容易，但我很喜歡。

examples.en: Kaohsiung is a big port city in southern Taiwan.
examples.zh: 高雄是台灣南部的大港口城市。

examples.en: We took the high-speed rail to Kaohsiung on Friday.
examples.zh: 我們星期五搭高鐵去高雄。

examples.en: My aunt runs a small shop in Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在高雄開了一家小店。

examples.en: Korea is well known for its music and food.
examples.zh: 韓國以音樂和美食聞名。

examples.en: My friend will study in Korea next year.
examples.zh: 我朋友明年要去韓國念書。

examples.en: We watched a show about travel in Korea.
examples.zh: 我們看了一個介紹韓國旅遊的節目。

examples.en: She likes to cook Korean food on weekends.
examples.zh: 她週末喜歡煮韓式料理。

examples.en: I am taking a Korean class after school.
examples.zh: 我放學後在上韓語課。

examples.en: The Korean singer gave a concert in Taipei.
examples.zh: 那位韓國歌手在台北開了演唱會。

examples.en: My teacher can speak Korean and English.
examples.zh: 我的老師會說韓語和英語。

examples.en: Many Koreans enjoy eating spicy food.
examples.zh: 許多韓國人喜歡吃辣的食物。

examples.en: Korean is written with a special alphabet.
examples.zh: 韓語是用一套特殊的字母系統書寫的。

examples.en: We went to a KTV to celebrate her birthday.
examples.zh: 我們去KTV幫她慶祝生日。

examples.en: The KTV near the station is open until midnight.
examples.zh: 車站附近的KTV營業到午夜。

examples.en: My classmates and I sang many songs at the KTV.
examples.zh: 我和同學在KTV唱了很多首歌。

examples.en: Take the next left-hand turn to reach the bank.
examples.zh: 在下一個路口左轉就能到銀行。

examples.en: He lost his left-hand glove while walking home from school.
examples.zh: 他放學走路回家時，弄丟了左手的手套。

examples.en: The restroom is on the left-hand side of the hall.
examples.zh: 洗手間在走廊的左手邊。

examples.en: My grandmother speaks Mandarin and Taiwanese at home.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在家說國語和台語。

examples.en: She teaches Mandarin to foreign students at a local university.
examples.zh: 她在當地的一所大學教外國學生國語。

examples.en: We bought a bag of sweet mandarin oranges at the market.
examples.zh: 我們在市場買了一袋甜的橘子。

examples.en: Please give me a glass of water.
examples.zh: 請給我一杯水。

examples.en: My sister sent me a photo from Japan.
examples.zh: 我姊姊從日本寄了一張照片給我。

examples.en: Can you help me carry these books?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我搬這些書嗎？

examples.en: It might rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
examples.zh: 今天下午可能會下雨，所以帶把傘吧。

examples.en: She might be late because of the traffic.
examples.zh: 她可能會因為塞車而遲到。

examples.en: We might visit our grandparents next weekend.
examples.zh: 我們下週末也許會去探望祖父母。

examples.en: I prepared this lunch myself before leaving for school.
examples.zh: 出門上學前，我自己準備了這份午餐。

examples.en: I cut myself while peeling the apple.
examples.zh: 我削蘋果時不小心割到自己。

examples.en: Let me introduce myself to the class.
examples.zh: 讓我向全班自我介紹一下。

examples.en: We cleaned the classroom ourselves after the party.
examples.zh: 派對結束後，我們自己打掃了教室。

examples.en: We enjoyed ourselves at the night market.
examples.zh: 我們在夜市玩得很開心。

examples.en: We should be proud of ourselves for finishing the project.
examples.zh: 我們完成這個專案，應該為自己感到驕傲。

examples.en: The Philippines has more than seven thousand islands.
examples.zh: 菲律賓有超過七千座島嶼。

examples.en: My neighbor comes from the Philippines and teaches English nearby.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居來自菲律賓，在附近教英文。

examples.en: Many tourists enjoy the beaches in the Philippines.
examples.zh: 許多觀光客喜歡菲律賓的海灘。

examples.en: My phone is almost out of battery.
examples.zh: 我的手機快沒電了。

examples.en: Please answer the phone if it rings.
examples.zh: 電話響的話請接一下。

examples.en: He talked to his mother on the phone for an hour.
examples.zh: 他和媽媽講了一個小時的電話。

examples.en: I will phone you when I get home.
examples.zh: 我到家時會打電話給你。

examples.en: She phoned the hotel to change her booking.
examples.zh: 她打電話給飯店更改訂房。

examples.en: Please phone the office before you come.
examples.zh: 來之前請先打電話到辦公室。

examples.en: Our plane leaves for Tokyo at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 我們的飛機九點飛往東京。

examples.en: The plane landed safely despite the strong wind.
examples.zh: 儘管風很強，飛機還是平安降落了。

examples.en: I looked out of the plane window and saw the clouds.
examples.zh: 我從飛機的窗戶往外看，看見了雲。

examples.en: The policewoman helped the lost child find his mother.
examples.zh: 那位女警幫迷路的孩子找到了媽媽。

examples.en: A policewoman stood at the corner directing traffic.
examples.zh: 一位女警站在轉角指揮交通。

examples.en: My aunt works as a policewoman in Taichung.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在台中擔任女警。

examples.en: The post office is on the right-hand side of the street.
examples.zh: 郵局在街道的右手邊。

examples.en: Please put the cup in the right-hand drawer.
examples.zh: 請把杯子放進右邊的抽屜。

examples.en: He lost his right-hand glove on the way to school.
examples.zh: 他上學途中弄丟了右手的手套。

examples.en: Russia is the largest country in the world.
examples.zh: 俄羅斯是世界上最大的國家。

examples.en: Winters in Russia can be extremely cold.
examples.zh: 俄羅斯的冬天可能會非常冷。

examples.en: My uncle once took a long train trip across Russia.
examples.zh: 我叔叔曾搭火車長途旅行橫越俄羅斯。

examples.en: The salesperson showed us several new laptops.
examples.zh: 銷售員向我們展示了幾台新的筆記型電腦。

examples.en: A friendly salesperson helped me choose a jacket.
examples.zh: 一位親切的店員幫我挑了一件外套。

examples.en: She works as a salesperson in a shoe store.
examples.zh: 她在一家鞋店當店員。

examples.en: Singapore is a small but very modern country.
examples.zh: 新加坡是個小而現代化的國家。

examples.en: We stayed in Singapore for three days.
examples.zh: 我們在新加坡待了三天。

examples.en: Her father often travels to Singapore for work.
examples.zh: 她的爸爸常因工作出差到新加坡。

examples.en: Somebody left a backpack in the classroom.
examples.zh: 有人把背包留在教室裡。

examples.en: I need somebody to help me with this math problem.
examples.zh: 我需要有人幫我解這道數學題。

examples.en: Is somebody waiting for you at the gate?
examples.zh: 有人在門口等你嗎？

examples.en: Taichung is known for its pleasant weather and bubble tea.
examples.zh: 台中以宜人的天氣和珍珠奶茶聞名。

examples.en: We visited a famous museum in Taichung last weekend.
examples.zh: 我們上週末參觀了台中一座有名的博物館。

examples.en: My cousin goes to university in Taichung.
examples.zh: 我表哥在台中念大學。

examples.en: Tainan is the oldest city in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台南是台灣最古老的城市。

examples.en: People travel to Tainan to enjoy its local snacks.
examples.zh: 人們到台南品嚐當地的小吃。

examples.en: We walked around old temples in Tainan.
examples.zh: 我們在台南的古老廟宇間散步。

examples.en: I love Taiwanese street food, especially fried chicken.
examples.zh: 我愛台灣的街頭小吃，尤其是炸雞。

examples.en: The Taiwanese team played well in the final game.
examples.zh: 台灣隊在決賽中表現得很好。

examples.en: She is learning to cook Taiwanese dishes.
examples.zh: 她正在學做台灣菜。

examples.en: Many Taiwanese enjoy hot pot in winter.
examples.zh: 許多台灣人在冬天喜歡吃火鍋。

examples.en: My grandfather speaks Taiwanese with his friends.
examples.zh: 我爺爺和朋友說台語。

examples.en: A Taiwanese won the prize at the science fair.
examples.zh: 一位台灣人在科展中得了獎。

examples.en: We had a big family dinner on Thanksgiving.
examples.zh: 感恩節那天，我們全家一起吃了豐盛的晚餐。

examples.en: Thanksgiving is celebrated in November in the United States.
examples.zh: 美國在十一月慶祝感恩節。

examples.en: Our teacher told us the story of Thanksgiving in class.
examples.zh: 老師在課堂上跟我們說了感恩節的故事。

examples.en: I will call them after dinner to discuss our travel plans.
examples.zh: 晚餐後我會打電話給他們，討論我們的旅行計畫。

examples.en: The teacher gave them some homework to finish before Friday.
examples.zh: 老師給了他們一些要在星期五之前完成的功課。

examples.en: These apples look fresh, so let's buy them.
examples.zh: 這些蘋果看起來很新鮮，我們買下它們吧。

senses.zh: 他們自己；她們自己；它們自己

examples.en: The students cleaned the room themselves after the birthday party.
examples.zh: 生日派對後，學生們自己打掃了房間。

examples.en: The kids enjoyed themselves at the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們在公園玩得很開心。

examples.en: They should be proud of themselves for working so hard.
examples.zh: 他們這麼努力，應該為自己感到驕傲。

examples.en: The doctor suggested a new treatment for his back pain.
examples.zh: 醫生建議用新的療法治療他的背痛。

examples.en: All customers should receive the same friendly treatment.
examples.zh: 所有顧客都應該得到同樣親切的對待。

examples.en: This water needs special treatment before people can drink it.
examples.zh: 這種水需要經過特別處理，人們才能飲用。

examples.en: We watch TV together after dinner in the living room.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐後會一起在客廳看電視。

examples.en: Please turn off the TV and do your homework.
examples.zh: 請關掉電視去寫功課。

examples.en: They bought a new TV for the living room.
examples.zh: 他們為客廳買了一台新電視。

examples.en: We have English class every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每個星期一早上都有英文課。

examples.en: We are going to the beach this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們這個週末要去海邊。

examples.en: Do we need to bring our own lunch?
examples.zh: 我們需要自己帶午餐嗎？

examples.en: She said she would call me after school.
examples.zh: 她說她放學後會打電話給我。

examples.en: Would you like some tea or coffee?
examples.zh: 你想喝點茶還是咖啡？

examples.en: When I was young, I would visit my grandparents every summer.
examples.zh: 我小時候，每年夏天都會去探望祖父母。

examples.en: Yeah, I think that is a great idea.
examples.zh: 是啊，我覺得那是個很棒的主意。

examples.en: Yeah, I finished my homework an hour ago.
examples.zh: 對，我一小時前就寫完功課了。

examples.en: "Are you coming to the party?" "Yeah, of course."
examples.zh: 「你會來參加派對嗎？」「會啊，當然。」

examples.en: Thank you for helping me with my homework.
examples.zh: 謝謝你協助我完成功課。

examples.en: Do you want to join us for lunch?
examples.zh: 你想和我們一起吃午餐嗎？

examples.en: I will call you as soon as I get home.
examples.zh: 我一到家就會打電話給你。

examples.en: Please show your ticket to the guard.
examples.zh: 請向警衛出示你的票。

examples.en: Is this your umbrella or mine, or does it belong to someone else?
examples.zh: 這把雨傘是你的、我的，還是別人的？

examples.en: Thank you for your help with the project.
examples.zh: 謝謝你們協助這個專案。

examples.en: I admire my teacher for her patience.
examples.zh: 我很敬佩我的老師有耐心。

examples.en: Tourists stopped to admire the view from the hill.
examples.zh: 遊客停下來欣賞山上的景色。

examples.en: Many students admire the captain of the baseball team.
examples.zh: 許多學生很欣賞棒球隊的隊長。

examples.en: The doctor advised him to get more sleep.
examples.zh: 醫生建議他多睡一點。

examples.en: I advise you to check the weather before you go.
examples.zh: 我勸你出門前先看看天氣。

examples.en: Our manager advised us to finish the report early.
examples.zh: 我們的經理建議我們提早完成報告。

examples.en: Children learn the alphabet in kindergarten before they start reading.
examples.zh: 孩子們在幼兒園開始學習閱讀之前，先學字母表。

examples.en: The English alphabet has twenty-six letters, from A to Z.
examples.zh: 英文字母表有二十六個字母，從 A 到 Z。

examples.en: She sang the alphabet song with her little brother.
examples.zh: 她和弟弟一起唱字母歌。

examples.en: An ambulance arrived at the school in five minutes.
examples.zh: 救護車五分鐘內就抵達了學校。

examples.en: Please make way for the ambulance on the road.
examples.zh: 請讓出道路給救護車。

examples.en: He called an ambulance when his neighbor fell down the stairs.
examples.zh: 鄰居從樓梯摔下來時，他叫了救護車。

examples.en: The children dressed as angels for the school play.
examples.zh: 孩子們為學校的戲劇打扮成天使。

examples.en: There is a small angel on top of the Christmas tree.
examples.zh: 聖誕樹的頂端有一個小天使。

examples.en: Our nurse is an angel who always helps people.
examples.zh: 我們的護理師是個總是幫助別人的天使。

examples.en: I apologize for being late to the meeting.
examples.zh: 我為開會遲到而道歉。

examples.en: He apologized to his mother for breaking the vase.
examples.zh: 他為打破花瓶向媽媽道歉。

examples.en: The store apologized to customers for the long wait.
examples.zh: 商店為讓顧客久等而道歉。

examples.en: She works as an assistant in a dentist's office.
examples.zh: 她在牙醫診所擔任助理。

examples.en: The shop assistant showed us where the shoes were.
examples.zh: 店員告訴我們鞋子放在哪裡。

examples.en: Our teacher asked her assistant to hand out the tests.
examples.zh: 老師請助理把考卷發下去。

examples.en: He was named assistant manager last month.
examples.zh: 他上個月被任命為副理。

examples.en: Ms. Lin is the assistant coach of our basketball team.
examples.zh: 林老師是我們籃球隊的助理教練。

examples.en: The assistant principal announced the new schedule.
examples.zh: 副校長宣布了新的時間表。

examples.en: I assume the store is closed on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我猜這家店星期天沒開。

examples.en: Don't assume that everyone knows the answer.
examples.zh: 不要以為每個人都知道答案。

examples.en: She will assume her new duties next Monday.
examples.zh: 她下星期一要開始承擔新的職責。

examples.en: We keep old boxes in the basement.
examples.zh: 我們把舊箱子放在地下室。

examples.en: The supermarket is in the basement of the mall.
examples.zh: 超級市場在購物中心的地下樓層。

examples.en: Water came into the basement after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，水流進了地下室。

examples.en: I don't want to go out; besides, it's raining.
examples.zh: 我不想出門，而且外面正在下雨。

examples.en: The hotel is cheap. Besides, it is near the station.
examples.zh: 這間旅館很便宜，而且離車站很近。

examples.en: It is too late to call. Besides, he may be asleep.
examples.zh: 現在打電話太晚了，而且他可能已經睡了。

examples.en: Besides English, she also speaks Japanese and a little Korean.
examples.zh: 除了英文以外，她也會說日文和一點韓文。

examples.en: Who else came to the party besides Tom?
examples.zh: 除了湯姆以外，還有誰來參加派對？

examples.en: Besides homework, we have a test tomorrow.
examples.zh: 除了作業以外，我們明天還有考試。

senses.zh: 苦的；憤憤不平的；嚴寒的

examples.en: This coffee tastes too bitter without sugar.
examples.zh: 這杯咖啡不加糖喝起來太苦了。

examples.en: She felt bitter about losing the game.
examples.zh: 她對輸掉比賽感到憤憤不平。

examples.en: A bitter wind blew across the empty field.
examples.zh: 刺骨的寒風吹過空曠的田野。

examples.en: She wore a white blouse and a black skirt.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件白襯衫和一條黑裙子。

examples.en: This blouse is too small for me.
examples.zh: 這件罩衫我穿太小了。

examples.en: My mother bought a silk blouse at the department store.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在百貨公司買了一件絲質襯衫。

examples.en: The old bomb was removed from the construction site.
examples.zh: 那顆舊炸彈已被從工地移走。

examples.en: Police closed the street after a bomb threat.
examples.zh: 接到炸彈威脅後，警方封鎖了街道。

examples.en: The museum displays a bomb found near the city after the war.
examples.zh: 博物館展示一顆戰後在城市附近發現的炸彈。

examples.en: Planes bombed the bridge during the war to stop enemy supplies.
examples.zh: 戰爭期間，飛機轟炸那座橋，以阻斷敵方的補給。

examples.en: The history book explains why they bombed the port.
examples.zh: 這本歷史書解釋了他們轟炸港口的原因。

examples.en: The old town was bombed many years ago.
examples.zh: 那座老城鎮多年前被轟炸過。

examples.en: There is a tall bookcase next to my desk.
examples.zh: 我的書桌旁邊有一個高高的書櫃。

examples.en: He put his dictionaries on the top shelf of the bookcase.
examples.zh: 他把字典放在書櫃的最上層。

examples.en: We bought a new bookcase for the living room.
examples.zh: 我們幫客廳買了一個新書櫃。

examples.en: My friends and I went bowling on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我和朋友星期六去打保齡球。

examples.en: Bowling is a popular sport in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 保齡球在台灣是很受歡迎的運動。

examples.en: The bowling alley is open until midnight.
examples.zh: 這間保齡球館營業到半夜。

examples.en: The radio station broadcasts news every hour.
examples.zh: 這家電台每小時播報新聞。

examples.en: The final game will be broadcast live tonight.
examples.zh: 決賽今晚將現場直播。

examples.en: They broadcast the school concert on the Internet.
examples.zh: 他們把學校音樂會在網路上播出。

examples.en: I listened to the morning broadcast on my way to work.
examples.zh: 我上班途中聽了早晨的廣播節目。

examples.en: The weather broadcast says it will rain tomorrow.
examples.zh: 氣象廣播說明天會下雨。

examples.en: The live broadcast began at eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 現場轉播在八點開始。

examples.en: We had brunch at a cafe on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們星期天在咖啡廳吃了早午餐。

examples.en: Brunch includes eggs, toast, and fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 早午餐有蛋、吐司和新鮮水果。

examples.en: Let's meet for brunch before the movie.
examples.zh: 我們看電影前先碰面吃早午餐吧。

examples.en: He filled the bucket with water from the tap.
examples.zh: 他用水龍頭的水把水桶裝滿。

examples.en: The children carried buckets of sand to the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子們提著幾桶沙子到海邊。

examples.en: Please put the wet cloth in the bucket.
examples.zh: 請把濕布放進桶子裡。

examples.en: The hotel serves a big breakfast buffet every morning.
examples.zh: 這間旅館每天早上都供應豐盛的自助早餐。

examples.en: We ate at a seafood buffet for my father's birthday.
examples.zh: 為了慶祝爸爸的生日，我們去吃了海鮮自助餐。

examples.en: There is a salad buffet next to the main dishes.
examples.zh: 主菜旁邊有一個沙拉自助吧。

examples.en: He carried a bundle of newspapers to the recycling center.
examples.zh: 他把一捆報紙帶到回收站。

examples.en: The farmer tied the sticks into a bundle.
examples.zh: 農夫把樹枝綁成一捆。

examples.en: She gave me a bundle of old letters.
examples.zh: 她給了我一捆舊信件。

examples.en: Please bundle the old magazines with string.
examples.zh: 請用繩子把舊雜誌捆起來。

examples.en: The workers bundled the cables before moving them.
examples.zh: 工人在搬動前先把電纜捆好。

examples.en: We bundled the vegetables and put them in a box.
examples.zh: 我們把蔬菜綁成一束，放進箱子裡。

examples.en: A thick cable connects the computer to the printer.
examples.zh: 一條粗電纜把電腦連接到印表機。

examples.en: The bridge is held up by strong steel cables.
examples.zh: 這座橋由堅固的鋼纜支撐。

examples.en: My grandparents watch cable every evening after they finish dinner.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母每天晚上吃完晚餐後都看有線電視。

examples.en: Students eat lunch in the school cafeteria.
examples.zh: 學生們在學校餐廳吃午餐。

examples.en: The cafeteria serves rice, vegetables, and soup.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳供應米飯、蔬菜和湯。

examples.en: We met our coach in the cafeteria after class.
examples.zh: 下課後我們在餐廳遇見了教練。

examples.en: The campus is full of tall trees and bicycles.
examples.zh: 校園裡滿是高大的樹木和腳踏車。

examples.en: New students took a tour of the campus.
examples.zh: 新生參加了校園導覽。

examples.en: Our university has two campuses in the city.
examples.zh: 我們大學在市區有兩個校區。

examples.en: Our captain led the team onto the field.
examples.zh: 我們的隊長帶領球隊走上球場。

examples.en: The captain of the ship welcomed everyone on board.
examples.zh: 船長歡迎所有人登船。

examples.en: The captain told the passengers to fasten their seat belts.
examples.zh: 機長請乘客繫好安全帶。

examples.en: She will captain the volleyball team this year.
examples.zh: 她今年將擔任排球隊的隊長。

examples.en: He captained the boat across the lake.
examples.zh: 他指揮船隻橫渡湖面。

examples.en: Who captained your team last season when you won the championship?
examples.zh: 你們球隊上一季贏得冠軍時，是誰擔任隊長？

examples.en: The living room has a soft gray carpet.
examples.zh: 客廳鋪著一條柔軟的灰色地毯。

examples.en: Please take off your shoes before walking on the carpet.
examples.zh: 走上地毯之前請先脫鞋。

examples.en: We rolled up the old carpet and carried it outside.
examples.zh: 我們把舊地毯捲起來搬到外面。

examples.en: She hung her coat in the closet.
examples.zh: 她把大衣掛在衣櫥裡。

examples.en: My brother keeps his sports shoes in the hall closet.
examples.zh: 我弟弟把運動鞋放在走廊的壁櫥裡。

examples.en: The closet is full of clothes I never wear.
examples.zh: 衣櫥裡塞滿了我從來不穿的衣服。

examples.en: Our basketball coach teaches us to work as a team.
examples.zh: 我們的籃球教練教我們團隊合作。

examples.en: The tour coach left the hotel at eight.
examples.zh: 遊覽車八點離開旅館。

examples.en: She is a vocal coach for young singers.
examples.zh: 她是年輕歌手的聲樂教練。

examples.en: Mr. Wang coaches the school baseball team.
examples.zh: 王老師指導學校的棒球隊。

examples.en: She coaches students for the speech contest.
examples.zh: 她指導學生準備演講比賽。

examples.en: My uncle coached me before the swimming test.
examples.zh: 游泳測驗前，我叔叔訓練過我。

examples.en: The market was full of colorful fruit and flowers.
examples.zh: 市場裡滿是色彩繽紛的水果和花朵。

examples.en: She wore a colorful scarf to the party.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條色彩鮮豔的圍巾去參加派對。

examples.en: The kids drew a colorful picture of the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們畫了一幅公園的彩色圖畫。

examples.en: Stop complaining about the food and eat your dinner.
examples.zh: 別再抱怨食物了，快吃你的晚餐。

examples.en: Customers complained about the slow service at the new restaurant.
examples.zh: 顧客抱怨那家新餐廳的服務太慢。

examples.en: He complained to the manager about the noisy room.
examples.zh: 他向經理投訴房間太吵。

examples.en: The long instructions confused many students during the science experiment.
examples.zh: 自然實驗時，冗長的說明讓許多學生感到困惑。

examples.en: Don't confuse the two words; they have different meanings.
examples.zh: 別把這兩個字搞混，它們的意思不同。

examples.en: The new schedule may confuse some passengers.
examples.zh: 新的時刻表可能會讓一些乘客搞不清楚。

examples.en: This shirt is made of soft cotton.
examples.zh: 這件襯衫是用柔軟的棉布做的。

examples.en: Farmers grow cotton in the warm fields.
examples.zh: 農夫在溫暖的田裡種棉花。

examples.en: She cleaned the cut with a piece of cotton.
examples.zh: 她用一小團棉花清理傷口。

examples.en: He coughed all night because of the cold.
examples.zh: 他因為感冒咳了一整晚。

examples.en: Please cover your mouth when you cough.
examples.zh: 咳嗽的時候請遮住嘴巴。

examples.en: The smoke made everyone in the room cough.
examples.zh: 煙讓房間裡的每個人都咳了起來。

examples.en: I have a bad cough and a sore throat.
examples.zh: 我咳得很厲害，喉嚨也痛。

examples.en: The doctor gave her medicine for her cough.
examples.zh: 醫生開了咳嗽藥給她。

examples.en: We heard a loud cough from the back of the class.
examples.zh: 我們聽到教室後面傳來很大的咳嗽聲。

examples.en: A small crab walked across the sand.
examples.zh: 一隻小螃蟹爬過沙灘。

examples.en: We had steamed crab for dinner at the seafood restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在海鮮餐廳晚餐吃了清蒸螃蟹。

examples.en: The children caught a crab in the shallow water.
examples.zh: 孩子們在淺水中抓到了一隻螃蟹。

examples.en: It is cruel to leave a dog outside in the cold.
examples.zh: 把狗留在寒冷的屋外是很殘忍的。

examples.en: The teacher told us not to be cruel to animals.
examples.zh: 老師告訴我們不要對動物殘忍。

examples.en: Her cruel words made him feel sad.
examples.zh: 她冷酷的話讓他覺得很難過。

examples.en: We woke up at dawn to see the sunrise.
examples.zh: 我們天一亮就起床看日出。

examples.en: The birds begin to sing at dawn.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在黎明時開始鳴唱。

examples.en: The invention marked the dawn of a new age.
examples.zh: 這項發明標誌著新時代的開端。

examples.en: The day dawned bright and clear after a night of heavy rain.
examples.zh: 下了一整夜大雨後，那天天亮時天氣晴朗。

examples.en: It suddenly dawned on me that I had left my keys at home.
examples.zh: 我忽然想到自己把鑰匙忘在家裡了。

examples.en: Morning dawned over the quiet village as farmers prepared for work.
examples.zh: 寧靜的村莊迎來黎明，農夫們正準備工作。

examples.en: We decorated the classroom for the festival.
examples.zh: 我們為節慶佈置了教室。

examples.en: She decorated the cake with strawberries for her sister's birthday.
examples.zh: 她為姊姊的生日，用草莓裝飾了蛋糕。

examples.en: They decorate the tree with lights every December.
examples.zh: 他們每年十二月都用燈飾裝飾那棵樹。

examples.en: The number of students decreased this year.
examples.zh: 今年的學生人數減少了。

examples.en: Exercise can decrease the risk of heart disease.
examples.zh: 運動可以降低心臟病的風險。

examples.en: Prices decrease when more stores sell the same product.
examples.zh: 當更多商店賣同樣的產品時，價格就會下降。

examples.en: There was a sharp decrease in sales last month.
examples.zh: 上個月的銷售量大幅下降。

examples.en: The report shows a decrease in air pollution.
examples.zh: 報告顯示空氣汙染減少了。

examples.en: A decrease in temperature is expected tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚預計氣溫會下降。

examples.en: She has a strong desire to study abroad.
examples.zh: 她很渴望出國留學。

examples.en: He felt no desire to eat after the long trip.
examples.zh: 長途旅行後，他一點也不想吃東西。

examples.en: Their desire for success helped them work hard.
examples.zh: 他們對成功的渴望讓他們努力工作。

examples.en: Everyone desires a safe and happy life.
examples.zh: 每個人都渴望安全快樂的生活。

examples.en: The company desires to hire more workers.
examples.zh: 公司希望能多聘請一些員工。

examples.en: He desired a quiet place to study.
examples.zh: 他想要一個安靜的地方念書。

examples.en: We shared a chocolate dessert after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後我們分著吃了一份巧克力甜點。

examples.en: What would you like for dessert tonight?
examples.zh: 你今晚想吃什麼甜點？

examples.en: This restaurant is famous for its mango dessert.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳以芒果甜點聞名。

examples.en: Dinosaurs lived on Earth millions of years ago.
examples.zh: 恐龍在數百萬年前生活在地球上。

examples.en: My little brother loves his toy dinosaur.
examples.zh: 我弟弟很喜歡他的玩具恐龍。

examples.en: We saw a giant dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
examples.zh: 我們在博物館看到一具巨大的恐龍骨架。

examples.en: It is dishonest to copy your friend's homework.
examples.zh: 抄朋友的作業是不誠實的。

examples.en: The dishonest seller gave us the wrong change.
examples.zh: 那個不誠實的賣家找錯錢給我們。

examples.en: Nobody trusts a dishonest person for long.
examples.zh: 沒有人會長久信任一個不誠實的人。

examples.en: I felt dizzy after riding the roller coaster.
examples.zh: 搭完雲霄飛車後，我覺得頭暈。

examples.en: She stood up too fast and became dizzy.
examples.zh: 她站起來太快，覺得頭暈目眩。

examples.en: The hot weather made the old man dizzy.
examples.zh: 炎熱的天氣讓老先生頭暈。

examples.en: A dolphin jumped out of the water near our boat.
examples.zh: 一隻海豚在我們的船旁邊躍出水面。

examples.en: Dolphins are smart animals that live in groups.
examples.zh: 海豚是群居的聰明動物。

examples.en: The children laughed at the dolphin show.
examples.zh: 孩子們被海豚表演逗得哈哈大笑。

examples.en: The farmer rode a donkey to the market.
examples.zh: 農夫騎著驢子去市場。

examples.en: A donkey carried the bags up the hill.
examples.zh: 一隻驢子把袋子載上山坡。

examples.en: The children fed carrots to the donkey.
examples.zh: 孩子們餵驢子吃紅蘿蔔。

examples.en: I bought a doughnut for breakfast on my way to school.
examples.zh: 我在上學途中買了一個甜甜圈當早餐。

examples.en: The doughnut shop is next to the bus stop.
examples.zh: 甜甜圈店就在公車站旁邊。

examples.en: She put sugar on each doughnut before serving them to guests.
examples.zh: 她把甜甜圈端給客人前，在每個上面加了糖。

examples.en: We took the bus downtown to see a movie.
examples.zh: 我們搭公車去市中心看電影。

examples.en: My aunt works downtown near the main station.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在主車站附近的市中心上班。

examples.en: They walked downtown after lunch to visit the new bookstore.
examples.zh: 午餐後，他們走路到市中心，逛那家新書店。

examples.en: The downtown area is busy on weekends.
examples.zh: 市中心地區在週末很熱鬧。

examples.en: We stayed at a downtown hotel last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天我們住在市中心的一家旅館。

examples.en: A new downtown library will open next year.
examples.zh: 一間位於市中心的新圖書館明年將開放。

examples.en: I bought cold medicine at the drugstore.
examples.zh: 我在藥妝店買了感冒藥。

examples.en: The drugstore on the corner closes at ten.
examples.zh: 轉角的藥局十點關門。

examples.en: She works at a drugstore near the school.
examples.zh: 她在學校附近的一家藥妝店工作。

examples.en: That was a dumb mistake, and I am sorry.
examples.zh: 那是個愚蠢的錯誤，我很抱歉。

examples.en: Don't call your classmate dumb; it hurts his feelings.
examples.zh: 不要說你的同學笨，那會傷他的心。

examples.en: It would be dumb to go out in this storm.
examples.zh: 在這種暴風雨中出門太蠢了。

examples.en: My grandmother makes delicious dumplings for Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在農曆新年會包好吃的餃子。

examples.en: We ordered a plate of steamed dumplings at the night market.
examples.zh: 我們在夜市點了一盤蒸餃。

examples.en: Would you like soup or dumplings with your lunch set?
examples.zh: 你的午餐套餐想配湯還是餃子？

examples.en: Students will elect a new class leader on Friday.
examples.zh: 學生們星期五要選出新的班長。

examples.en: The members voted to elect Ms. Chen as club president.
examples.zh: 成員們投票選出陳小姐擔任社長。

examples.en: Citizens elect their mayor every four years in this city.
examples.zh: 這座城市的市民每四年選一次市長。

examples.en: She looked at his new bike with envy.
examples.zh: 她羨慕地看著他的新腳踏車。

examples.en: Envy is a common feeling when friends get better grades.
examples.zh: 朋友成績比較好時，羨慕是很常見的感受。

examples.en: His success filled his classmates with envy.
examples.zh: 他的成功讓同學們心生嫉妒。

examples.en: I envy you because you can speak three languages.
examples.zh: 我很羨慕你，因為你會說三種語言。

examples.en: Many people envy her calm attitude toward work.
examples.zh: 許多人羨慕她面對工作的沉著態度。

examples.en: He does not envy his brother's busy schedule at all.
examples.zh: 他一點也不羨慕哥哥忙碌的行程。

examples.en: We had dinner at a fancy restaurant for her birthday.
examples.zh: 我們為了她的生日去一家高級餐廳吃晚餐。

examples.en: I do not need a fancy phone; a simple one is enough.
examples.zh: 我不需要花俏的手機，簡單的就夠了。

examples.en: She wore a fancy dress to her cousin's wedding.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件華麗的洋裝去參加表姊的婚禮。

examples.en: Do you fancy a cup of tea after the long walk?
examples.zh: 走了這麼遠的路，你想不想喝杯茶？

examples.en: I fancy going to the beach this weekend.
examples.zh: 我這個週末想去海邊。

examples.en: She really fancies the red jacket in the shop window.
examples.zh: 她真的很喜歡櫥窗裡的那件紅外套。

examples.en: This jacket is very fashionable among teenagers right now.
examples.zh: 這件夾克現在在青少年之間非常流行。

examples.en: She always looks fashionable in her simple clothes.
examples.zh: 她穿著簡單的衣服，看起來總是很時髦。

examples.en: The cafe is a fashionable place for young office workers.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡廳是年輕上班族愛去的時髦地方。

examples.en: Please turn off the faucet while you brush your teeth.
examples.zh: 刷牙時請把水龍頭關上。

examples.en: The kitchen faucet is leaking again, so we need a plumber.
examples.zh: 廚房的水龍頭又漏水了，所以我們需要請水電工。

examples.en: Turn the faucet to the left to get hot water.
examples.zh: 把水龍頭往左轉就會出熱水。

examples.en: There is a white fence around the garden.
examples.zh: 花園周圍有一道白色的圍籬。

examples.en: The dog jumped over the fence and ran into the park.
examples.zh: 那隻狗跳過柵欄，跑進公園。

examples.en: Dad is painting the old wooden fence this weekend.
examples.zh: 爸爸這個週末要粉刷那道舊木頭圍籬。

examples.en: Bring a flashlight in case the power goes out.
examples.zh: 帶一支手電筒，以備停電時使用。

examples.en: I used my flashlight to find the keys under the bed.
examples.zh: 我用手電筒找到床底下的鑰匙。

examples.en: The batteries in this flashlight are almost dead.
examples.zh: 這支手電筒的電池快沒電了。

examples.en: You need two cups of flour to make this cake.
examples.zh: 做這個蛋糕需要兩杯麵粉。

examples.en: Mom bought a big bag of flour at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 媽媽在超市買了一大袋麵粉。

examples.en: Mix the flour with eggs and milk to make the dough.
examples.zh: 把麵粉和雞蛋、牛奶混合，做成麵糰。

examples.en: She plays the flute in the school band.
examples.zh: 她在學校樂隊裡吹長笛。

examples.en: The sound of the flute made the room feel calm.
examples.zh: 長笛的聲音讓房間感覺很平靜。

examples.en: He has taken flute lessons since he was ten.
examples.zh: 他從十歲起就在上長笛課。

examples.en: Let me be frank with you about the price.
examples.zh: 讓我坦率地跟你談談價格的事。

examples.en: She gave a frank answer to the interviewer's question.
examples.zh: 她對面試官的問題給了坦率的回答。

examples.en: We had a frank talk about how to improve the team.
examples.zh: 我們針對如何改進團隊進行了一次坦誠的談話。

examples.en: Please put the ice cream back in the freezer.
examples.zh: 請把冰淇淋放回冷凍庫。

examples.en: There is plenty of frozen fish in the freezer.
examples.zh: 冷凍庫裡有很多冷凍魚。

examples.en: Our freezer stopped working during the hot summer.
examples.zh: 我們的冷凍櫃在炎熱的夏天故障了。

examples.en: The loud thunder frightened the little girl.
examples.zh: 響亮的雷聲嚇到了那個小女孩。

examples.en: Do not frighten the cat; it is very shy.
examples.zh: 別嚇那隻貓，牠很害羞。

examples.en: Stories about ghosts used to frighten me when I was young.
examples.zh: 小時候，鬼故事常常嚇到我。

examples.en: Dad parked the car in the garage before dinner.
examples.zh: 爸爸在晚餐前把車停進車庫。

examples.en: We keep our bicycles and tools in the garage.
examples.zh: 我們把腳踏車和工具放在車庫裡。

examples.en: I took my car to the garage to fix the brakes.
examples.zh: 我把車開到修車廠修理煞車。

examples.en: Geography is my favorite subject at school.
examples.zh: 地理是我在學校最喜歡的科目。

examples.en: The teacher showed us a map in geography class.
examples.zh: 老師在地理課上給我們看了一張地圖。

examples.en: The geography of Taiwan includes high mountains and long coasts.
examples.zh: 台灣的地形包括高山和綿長的海岸。

examples.en: He waved his hand as a gesture of goodbye.
examples.zh: 他揮手示意道別。

examples.en: Giving up your seat is a kind gesture.
examples.zh: 讓座是一個親切的舉動。

examples.en: A thumbs-up gesture means good job in many countries.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，豎起大拇指的手勢表示做得好。

examples.en: The guide gestured toward the old temple with his hand.
examples.zh: 導遊用手朝那座老廟比了一下。

examples.en: She gestured for me to sit down next to her.
examples.zh: 她示意我坐到她旁邊。

examples.en: The waiter gestured to the empty table by the window.
examples.zh: 服務生朝窗邊的空桌比了個手勢。

examples.en: My father plays golf with his friends on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我爸爸星期天和朋友打高爾夫球。

examples.en: Golf is not as popular as baseball in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣，高爾夫球不像棒球那麼受歡迎。

examples.en: He bought a new set of golf clubs for his birthday.
examples.zh: 他為自己的生日買了一套新的高爾夫球桿。

examples.en: The greedy boy ate all the cookies by himself.
examples.zh: 那個貪心的男孩自己把餅乾全吃光了。

examples.en: Do not be greedy; share the cake with your sister.
examples.zh: 別貪心，把蛋糕和你姊姊分著吃。

examples.en: The company was greedy and raised its prices again.
examples.zh: 那家公司很貪婪，又調漲了價格。

examples.en: Dad used a hammer to put the nail into the wall.
examples.zh: 爸爸用鐵鎚把釘子釘進牆裡。

examples.en: Please pass me the hammer from the toolbox.
examples.zh: 請把工具箱裡的鐵鎚遞給我。

examples.en: This hammer is much heavier than it looks, so be careful.
examples.zh: 這支鐵鎚比看起來重很多，所以要小心。

examples.en: He hammered the nail into the wooden board carefully.
examples.zh: 他小心地把釘子敲進木板裡。

examples.en: Heavy rain hammered on the tin roof all night.
examples.zh: 大雨整晚猛敲著鐵皮屋頂。

examples.en: Workers hammered the fence posts into the ground.
examples.zh: 工人們把柵欄的柱子搥進地裡。

examples.en: She wiped away her tears with a clean handkerchief.
examples.zh: 她用一條乾淨的手帕擦去眼淚。

examples.en: Grandpa always carries a handkerchief in his pocket.
examples.zh: 爺爺口袋裡總是帶著一條手帕。

examples.en: I gave my mother a silk handkerchief for her birthday.
examples.zh: 我送了媽媽一條絲質手帕當生日禮物。

examples.en: Please put your wet coat on a hanger to dry.
examples.zh: 請把你的濕外套掛在衣架上晾乾。

examples.en: I need more hangers for the clothes in my closet.
examples.zh: 我的衣櫃裡需要更多衣架來掛衣服。

examples.en: The shop gives you a plastic hanger with every shirt.
examples.zh: 這家店每買一件襯衫都會附一個塑膠衣架。

examples.en: Please turn on the heater; it is very cold in the room.
examples.zh: 請打開電暖器，房間裡很冷。

examples.en: We bought a new water heater for the bathroom.
examples.zh: 我們幫浴室買了一台新的熱水器。

examples.en: The old heater in the classroom makes a strange noise.
examples.zh: 教室裡那台舊暖氣機會發出奇怪的聲音。

examples.en: The restaurant plans to hire two new waiters next month.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳計畫下個月僱用兩名新服務生。

examples.en: We decided to hire a bus for the school trip.
examples.zh: 我們決定為校外教學租一輛巴士。

examples.en: They hired a tutor to help their son with math.
examples.zh: 他們聘請了一位家教幫兒子補數學。

examples.en: I felt homesick during my first week abroad.
examples.zh: 我出國的第一週覺得很想家。

examples.en: The new student was homesick and missed her family.
examples.zh: 那位新生很想家，想念她的家人。

examples.en: Are you homesick, or do you enjoy living in the dorm?
examples.zh: 你會想家嗎，還是你喜歡住宿舍？

examples.en: Honesty is the best policy, especially at work.
examples.zh: 誠實是上策，尤其是在工作上。

examples.en: I admire her honesty when she admits a mistake.
examples.zh: 我很欣賞她承認錯誤時的誠實。

examples.en: The teacher praised the boy for his honesty.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚那個男孩的誠實。

examples.en: The weather was horrible, so we stayed home all day.
examples.zh: 天氣糟糕透了，所以我們整天待在家。

examples.en: I had a horrible dream about missing the final exam.
examples.zh: 我做了一個關於錯過期末考的可怕的夢。

examples.en: The soup tasted horrible, so I could not finish it.
examples.zh: 這碗湯的味道糟透了，所以我喝不完。

examples.en: Summers in Taipei are hot and humid.
examples.zh: 台北的夏天又熱又潮濕。

examples.en: The air feels very humid just before it starts to rain.
examples.zh: 下雨前，空氣感覺非常潮濕。

examples.en: Keep dried mushrooms in a cool place, away from humid air.
examples.zh: 乾香菇要放在涼爽的地方，遠離潮濕的空氣。

examples.en: Her sense of humor makes everyone in the class laugh.
examples.zh: 她的幽默感讓班上每個人都笑了。

examples.en: The movie has a lot of humor, so the kids enjoyed it.
examples.zh: 這部電影很幽默，所以孩子們很喜歡。

examples.en: He answered the difficult question with a little humor.
examples.zh: 他用一點幽默回答了那個困難的問題。

examples.en: The teacher gave a humorous speech at the graduation.
examples.zh: 老師在畢業典禮上發表了一場幽默的演講。

examples.en: I like this humorous story about a talking dog.
examples.zh: 我喜歡這個關於會說話的狗的幽默故事。

examples.en: His humorous way of talking makes meetings less boring.
examples.zh: 他幽默的說話方式讓會議沒那麼無聊。

examples.en: Hunger made it hard for him to focus in class.
examples.zh: 飢餓讓他在課堂上很難專心。

examples.en: Many charities around the world work to end hunger.
examples.zh: 世界各地有許多慈善團體致力於消除飢餓。
