examples.en: She has a great hunger for knowledge and loves reading.
examples.zh: 她對知識有強烈的渴望，也愛閱讀。

examples.en: You can find more information on our website.
examples.zh: 你可以在我們的網站上找到更多資訊。

examples.en: Could you give me some information about the trip?
examples.zh: 你可以給我一些關於這次旅行的資訊嗎？

examples.en: The information in this email is very useful.
examples.zh: 這封電子郵件裡的資訊非常有用。

examples.en: She is an intelligent student who learns quickly.
examples.zh: 她是個學得很快的聰明學生。

examples.en: Dolphins are intelligent animals that can learn many tricks.
examples.zh: 海豚是很聰明的動物，能學會許多把戲。

examples.en: That was an intelligent decision to save money.
examples.zh: 存錢是個明智的決定。

examples.en: Please do not interrupt me while I am speaking.
examples.zh: 我在說話時請不要打斷我。

examples.en: Sorry to interrupt, but the manager wants to see you.
examples.zh: 抱歉打擾一下，經理想見你。

examples.en: A loud phone call interrupted our family dinner last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚一通很大聲的電話打斷了我們的家庭晚餐。

examples.en: Thomas Edison invented many useful machines during his life.
examples.zh: 愛迪生一生發明了許多有用的機器。

examples.en: The students invented a new game for the school party.
examples.zh: 學生們為學校派對創造了一個新遊戲。

examples.en: She invented an excuse to leave the meeting early.
examples.zh: 她編造了一個藉口提早離開會議。

examples.en: Thank you for the invitation to your birthday party.
examples.zh: 謝謝你邀請我參加你的生日派對。

examples.en: We sent all the wedding invitations to our friends last week.
examples.zh: 我們上週把所有婚禮邀請函都寄給朋友了。

examples.en: I received an invitation to speak at the school event.
examples.zh: 我收到了在校內活動演講的邀請。

examples.en: My uncle loves listening to jazz in the evening.
examples.zh: 我叔叔喜歡在晚上聽爵士樂。

examples.en: The cafe plays soft jazz on weekend afternoons.
examples.zh: 那家咖啡廳在週末下午播放輕柔的爵士樂。

examples.en: She joined the school jazz band last year.
examples.zh: 她去年加入了學校的爵士樂團。

examples.en: She felt jealous when her friend won the prize.
examples.zh: 朋友得獎時，她感到嫉妒。

examples.en: He is jealous of his brother's new bicycle.
examples.zh: 他嫉妒哥哥的新腳踏車。

examples.en: My dog gets jealous when I pet the cat.
examples.zh: 當我摸貓的時候，我的狗會吃醋。

examples.en: We rented a jeep to drive through the mountains.
examples.zh: 我們租了一輛吉普車開過山區。

examples.en: The old jeep climbed the muddy hill very slowly.
examples.zh: 那輛老吉普車非常緩慢地爬上泥濘的山坡。

examples.en: My uncle drives a green jeep to his farm.
examples.zh: 我叔叔開一輛綠色吉普車去他的農場。

examples.en: A kangaroo carries its baby in a pouch.
examples.zh: 袋鼠把牠的寶寶放在育兒袋裡。

examples.en: We saw a kangaroo jumping across the field at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園看到一隻袋鼠跳過草地。

examples.en: Kangaroos live in Australia and mostly eat grass and leaves.
examples.zh: 袋鼠住在澳洲，主要吃草和樹葉。

examples.en: The school is only two kilometers from my house.
examples.zh: 學校離我家只有兩公里。

examples.en: He runs five kilometers every morning before work.
examples.zh: 他每天早上上班前跑五公里。

examples.en: How many kilometers is it from Taipei to Taichung?
examples.zh: 台北到台中有幾公里？

examples.en: My little sister goes to kindergarten every morning.
examples.zh: 我妹妹每天早上去上幼兒園。

examples.en: The kindergarten teacher reads a story to the children.
examples.zh: 幼兒園老師念故事給孩子們聽。

examples.en: Most kids learn to write their names in kindergarten.
examples.zh: 大多數孩子在幼兒園學會寫自己的名字。

examples.en: The princess lived happily in a small kingdom by the sea.
examples.zh: 公主快樂地住在海邊的小王國裡。

examples.en: Long ago, a wise king ruled this kingdom.
examples.zh: 很久以前，一位睿智的國王統治著這個王國。

examples.en: In science class, we learned about the animal kingdom.
examples.zh: 在自然課上，我們學到了動物界。

examples.en: The koala slept in the tree for most of the day.
examples.zh: 無尾熊大半天都在樹上睡覺。

examples.en: Koalas mostly eat eucalyptus leaves and sleep up to twenty hours a day.
examples.zh: 無尾熊主要吃尤加利葉，一天最多睡二十小時。

examples.en: Many tourists want to hold a koala in Australia.
examples.zh: 許多遊客想在澳洲抱無尾熊。

examples.en: Please add some lettuce to my sandwich.
examples.zh: 請在我的三明治裡加一些生菜。

examples.en: The farmer grows lettuce and carrots behind his house.
examples.zh: 農夫在房子後面種生菜和紅蘿蔔。

examples.en: A fresh lettuce salad goes well with grilled fish.
examples.zh: 新鮮的生菜沙拉很適合搭配烤魚。

examples.en: The dog likes to lick my hand when I come home.
examples.zh: 我回家時，狗喜歡舔我的手。

examples.en: Do not lick your fingers; wash your hands first.
examples.zh: 不要舔手指，先去洗手。

examples.en: The child licked the ice cream before it melted.
examples.zh: 孩子在冰淇淋融化前舔了一口。

examples.en: We saw a flash of lightning over the mountains.
examples.zh: 我們看到山上有一道閃電。

examples.en: Lightning struck the tall tree behind the school.
examples.zh: 閃電擊中了學校後面那棵高大的樹。

examples.en: Stay away from open fields when there is lightning.
examples.zh: 有閃電時，要遠離空曠的田野。

examples.en: I bought a loaf of bread at the bakery.
examples.zh: 我在麵包店買了一條麵包。

examples.en: She cut the warm loaf into thick slices for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她把還溫熱的麵包切成厚片當早餐。

examples.en: This bakery sells a loaf of fresh bread for sixty dollars.
examples.zh: 這家麵包店一條新鮮麵包賣六十元。

examples.en: I cannot open the door because the lock is broken.
examples.zh: 門鎖壞了，所以我打不開門。

examples.en: Dad changed the lock on the front door last week.
examples.zh: 爸爸上週換了前門的鎖。

examples.en: This bike lock is strong enough to stop thieves.
examples.zh: 這個腳踏車鎖夠堅固，能擋住小偷。

examples.en: Please lock the door when you leave the office.
examples.zh: 離開辦公室時請鎖門。

examples.en: She locked her phone in the drawer before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前她把手機鎖在抽屜裡。

examples.en: He locked himself out of the house again.
examples.zh: 他又把自己鎖在屋外了。

examples.en: The loser of the game must buy drinks for everyone.
examples.zh: 比賽的輸家要請大家喝飲料。

examples.en: He is a good loser and always shakes hands with the winner.
examples.zh: 他輸得很有風度，總會和贏家握手。

examples.en: Do not call yourself a loser just because you failed once.
examples.zh: 別因為失敗一次就說自己是失敗者。

examples.en: The magician pulled a rabbit out of his hat.
examples.zh: 魔術師從帽子裡拉出一隻兔子。

examples.en: The kids laughed when the magician made a coin disappear.
examples.zh: 魔術師讓硬幣消失時，孩子們都笑了。

examples.en: My cousin wants to become a magician when he grows up.
examples.zh: 我表弟長大後想成為魔術師。

examples.en: We spent the whole afternoon shopping at the mall.
examples.zh: 我們整個下午都在購物中心逛街。

examples.en: The new mall has a cinema on the top floor.
examples.zh: 新的購物中心頂樓有一間電影院。

examples.en: Meet me in front of the mall entrance at six.
examples.zh: 六點在購物中心入口前面跟我碰面。

examples.en: The school band will march down the main street.
examples.zh: 學校樂隊將沿著大街行進。

examples.en: The students marched into the hall in two lines.
examples.zh: 學生們排成兩列走進禮堂。

examples.en: Thousands of people marched through the city to protect the river.
examples.zh: 數千人走過市區，為保護河川而遊行。

examples.en: The soldiers' march lasted for three hours.
examples.zh: 士兵們的行進持續了三個小時。

examples.en: The band played a lively march at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 樂隊在典禮上演奏了一首輕快的進行曲。

examples.en: My birthday is in March, so we always celebrate in spring.
examples.zh: 我的生日在三月，所以我們總是在春天慶祝。

examples.en: Please write your name on the board with a marker.
examples.zh: 請用白板筆把你的名字寫在白板上。

examples.en: The teacher gave each group a red marker and a poster.
examples.zh: 老師給每組一支紅色記號筆和一張海報。

examples.en: A small marker shows where the trail begins.
examples.zh: 一個小標記指出步道的起點。

senses.zh: 很棒的；絕妙的；了不起的

examples.en: We had a marvelous time at the beach last weekend.
examples.zh: 上週末我們在海邊玩得非常開心。

examples.en: The chef prepared a marvelous dinner for our guests.
examples.zh: 主廚為我們的客人準備了一頓絕妙的晚餐。

examples.en: It is marvelous that so many students joined the club.
examples.zh: 有這麼多學生加入社團真是太棒了。

examples.en: Put the soup in the microwave for two minutes.
examples.zh: 把湯放進微波爐加熱兩分鐘。

examples.en: Our office kitchen has a microwave and a small fridge.
examples.zh: 我們辦公室的廚房有一台微波爐和一台小冰箱。

examples.en: The microwave beeped when the milk was warm.
examples.zh: 牛奶熱好時，微波爐發出嗶聲。

examples.en: Please microwave the rice before you serve it.
examples.zh: 上菜前請先用微波爐加熱米飯。

examples.en: I microwaved a bowl of noodles for a quick lunch.
examples.zh: 我用微波爐加熱一碗麵當作簡單的午餐。

examples.en: Do not microwave food in a metal container.
examples.zh: 不要把食物放在金屬容器裡用微波爐加熱。

examples.en: Ten minus four equals six, as shown on the board.
examples.zh: 如黑板上所示，十減四等於六。

examples.en: The total is fifty dollars minus the discount.
examples.zh: 總額是五十元減掉折扣。

examples.en: Your final score is the test score minus the late penalty.
examples.zh: 你的最後分數是考試分數減去遲交的扣分。

examples.en: Draw a minus in front of the number to make it negative.
examples.zh: 在數字前面畫一個負號，使它變成負數。

examples.en: The long commute is the only minus of this job.
examples.zh: 通勤時間長是這份工作唯一的缺點。

examples.en: Every plan has pluses and minuses that we should consider.
examples.zh: 每個計畫都有優點和缺點，我們應該考慮。

examples.en: The kids hid under the blanket during the monster movie.
examples.zh: 孩子們看怪物電影時躲在毯子底下。

examples.en: My little brother drew a green monster with three eyes.
examples.zh: 我弟弟畫了一隻有三隻眼睛的綠色怪物。

examples.en: Legend says a monster lives at the bottom of the lake.
examples.zh: 傳說有一隻怪物住在湖底。

examples.en: A mosquito kept buzzing around my ear all night.
examples.zh: 一隻蚊子整晚都在我耳邊嗡嗡叫。

examples.en: Wear long sleeves to protect yourself from mosquito bites in the forest.
examples.zh: 在森林裡穿長袖衣物，保護自己免受蚊子叮咬。

examples.en: The mosquito net kept us safe while we slept in the tent.
examples.zh: 我們在帳篷裡睡覺時，蚊帳保護了我們。

examples.en: Please put a napkin on your lap before you eat.
examples.zh: 吃飯前請把餐巾放在腿上。

examples.en: The waiter brought us extra napkins with the burgers.
examples.zh: 服務生隨漢堡多送來了幾張餐巾紙。

examples.en: She folded the paper napkin into the shape of a bird.
examples.zh: 她把紙餐巾摺成鳥的形狀。

examples.en: A small bird built a nest in the tree outside my window.
examples.zh: 一隻小鳥在我窗外的樹上築了一個巢。

examples.en: The eggs in the nest hatched in early spring.
examples.zh: 巢裡的蛋在初春孵化了。

examples.en: We found a wasp nest under the roof of the barn.
examples.zh: 我們在穀倉屋簷下發現了一個黃蜂窩。

examples.en: Swallows nest under the roofs of old houses every year.
examples.zh: 燕子每年都在老房子的屋簷下築巢。

examples.en: A pair of ducks nested near the pond in our school.
examples.zh: 一對鴨子在我們學校的池塘附近築巢。

examples.en: The birds usually nest high in the trees to stay safe.
examples.zh: 這些鳥通常在高高的樹上築巢，以保安全。

examples.en: Please do not omit your phone number from the form.
examples.zh: 請不要在表格中漏填你的電話號碼。

examples.en: The editor decided to omit the last paragraph of the article.
examples.zh: 編輯決定刪去文章的最後一段。

examples.en: If you omit the salt, the soup will taste plain.
examples.zh: 如果不加鹽，湯的味道會很淡。

examples.en: Chopping an onion always makes my eyes water.
examples.zh: 切洋蔥總是讓我眼睛流淚。

examples.en: My mother added a sliced onion to the beef soup.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在牛肉湯裡加了一顆切片的洋蔥。

examples.en: Would you like extra onion on your hamburger?
examples.zh: 你的漢堡要加多一點洋蔥嗎？

examples.en: The doctor said Grandpa needs an operation on his knee.
examples.zh: 醫生說爺爺的膝蓋需要動手術。

examples.en: The factory's operation was stopped for a safety check.
examples.zh: 工廠的運作因安全檢查而暫停。

examples.en: Addition is the first math operation children learn.
examples.zh: 加法是孩子最先學的數學運算。

examples.en: Heat the oven to two hundred degrees before baking.
examples.zh: 烘焙前先把烤箱預熱到兩百度。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread came from the oven.
examples.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味從烤箱裡飄出來。

examples.en: Be careful, because the oven door is still hot.
examples.zh: 小心，烤箱門還很燙。

examples.en: My uncle works overseas and visits us once a year.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在海外工作，一年回來看我們一次。

examples.en: She plans to study overseas after she finishes high school.
examples.zh: 她打算高中畢業後到國外讀書。

examples.en: Many Taiwanese companies sell their products overseas.
examples.zh: 許多台灣公司把產品賣到海外。

examples.en: Our company has an overseas office in Singapore.
examples.zh: 我們公司在新加坡有一間海外辦公室。

examples.en: Overseas students must show their passports at registration.
examples.zh: 海外學生註冊時必須出示護照。

examples.en: Overseas travel became popular again last year.
examples.zh: 出國旅遊去年又重新熱門起來。

examples.en: The farmer used an ox to pull the heavy cart.
examples.zh: 農夫用一頭牛來拉那輛沉重的貨車。

examples.en: An ox is strong enough to carry a lot of goods.
examples.zh: 牛的力氣大到足以載運許多貨物。

examples.en: This year is the Year of the Ox in the Chinese zodiac.
examples.zh: 今年在十二生肖中是牛年。

examples.en: The painter set up her easel by the river.
examples.zh: 畫家把她的畫架架在河邊。

examples.en: My uncle is a house painter and works all over the city.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是房屋油漆工，在城裡到處工作。

examples.en: Van Gogh is a painter many students learn about in art class.
examples.zh: 梵谷是許多學生在美術課認識的畫家。

examples.en: The parrot can say hello to every visitor.
examples.zh: 這隻鸚鵡會向每位訪客說哈囉。

examples.en: Our neighbor keeps a colorful parrot in a large cage.
examples.zh: 我們的鄰居在大鳥籠裡養了一隻色彩繽紛的鸚鵡。

examples.en: A parrot can copy the sounds it hears at home.
examples.zh: 鸚鵡能模仿牠在家裡聽到的聲音。

examples.en: Don't just parrot what the teacher says; think for yourself.
examples.zh: 不要只是鸚鵡學舌地重複老師說的話，要自己思考。

examples.en: He parrots his boss's opinions in every meeting.
examples.zh: 他在每次會議上都重複老闆的意見。

examples.en: The child parroted the song after hearing it once.
examples.zh: 孩子聽了一遍就把那首歌照樣唱了出來。

examples.en: Every passenger must wear a seat belt in the taxi.
examples.zh: 計程車上的每位乘客都必須繫安全帶。

examples.en: The bus was so crowded that some passengers had to stand.
examples.zh: 公車非常擁擠，有些乘客只好站著。

examples.en: The airline asked all passengers to board at Gate Ten.
examples.zh: 航空公司請所有旅客到十號登機門登機。

examples.en: Please pause the video so I can take notes.
examples.zh: 請暫停影片，讓我可以做筆記。

examples.en: She paused at the door and looked back at us.
examples.zh: 她在門口停了一下，回頭看我們。

examples.en: The speaker paused for a moment to drink some water.
examples.zh: 演講者停頓了一會兒喝點水。

examples.en: After a short pause, the teacher continued the lesson.
examples.zh: 短暫停頓後，老師繼續上課。

examples.en: There was a long pause before he answered the question.
examples.zh: 他回答問題之前沉默了很久。

examples.en: Press the pause button if you need to answer the phone.
examples.zh: 如果你要接電話，請按暫停鍵。

examples.en: Please pass me the salt and pepper.
examples.zh: 請把鹽和胡椒遞給我。

examples.en: My father grows hot pepper plants on our balcony.
examples.zh: 我爸爸在我們的陽台上種辣椒。

examples.en: Add a sliced green pepper to the fried rice.
examples.zh: 在炒飯裡加入一個切片的青椒。

senses.zh: 撒胡椒粉；使佈滿；接連提問

examples.en: Please pepper the steak lightly before you cook it.
examples.zh: 煎牛排之前請輕輕撒上胡椒粉。

examples.en: The teacher peppered her speech with funny stories.
examples.zh: 老師在演講中穿插了許多有趣的故事。

examples.en: He peppered the guide with questions about the old temple.
examples.zh: 他不斷向導遊提出關於那座老廟的問題。

examples.en: A pigeon sat on the window and looked at us.
examples.zh: 一隻鴿子停在窗台上看著我們。

examples.en: Tourists like to feed the pigeons in the square.
examples.zh: 遊客喜歡在廣場上餵鴿子。

examples.en: Long ago, people used a pigeon to carry messages.
examples.zh: 很久以前，人們用鴿子傳遞訊息。

examples.en: There is a pile of books on my desk.
examples.zh: 我的書桌上有一堆書。

examples.en: The children jumped into a big pile of leaves.
examples.zh: 孩子們跳進一大堆落葉裡。

examples.en: She put the pile of clean towels in the closet.
examples.zh: 她把那疊乾淨的毛巾放進衣櫃。

examples.en: Please pile the boxes neatly against the wall.
examples.zh: 請把箱子整齊地堆在牆邊。

examples.en: Homework started to pile up before the final exam.
examples.zh: 期末考之前功課開始越積越多。

examples.en: Snow piled high on the roofs after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雪過後，屋頂上積了厚厚的雪。

examples.en: Taiwanese pineapple cakes make a popular gift for visitors.
examples.zh: 台灣的鳳梨酥是送給訪客的熱門伴手禮。

examples.en: I ordered a glass of pineapple juice with my lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐點了一杯鳳梨汁。

examples.en: This pineapple is sweet and juicy, so we bought another one.
examples.zh: 這顆鳳梨又甜又多汁，所以我們又買了一顆。

examples.en: Factories should not pollute the river near our town.
examples.zh: 工廠不應該污染我們小鎮附近的河川。

examples.en: Cars that burn gas pollute the air in big cities.
examples.zh: 燒汽油的汽車會污染大城市的空氣。

examples.en: Throwing trash into the sea can pollute it for years.
examples.zh: 把垃圾丟進海裡會讓海洋被污染好多年。

examples.en: Air pollution is a serious problem in many large cities.
examples.zh: 空氣污染在許多大城市是嚴重的問題。

examples.en: Students joined a clean-up to reduce pollution in the river.
examples.zh: 學生們參加了淨溪活動，以減少河川的污染。

examples.en: Noise pollution makes it hard to sleep near the airport.
examples.zh: 噪音污染讓人很難在機場附近入睡。

examples.en: Add two spoons of milk powder to the warm water.
examples.zh: 在溫水裡加入兩匙奶粉。

examples.en: She put some powder on her face before the photo.
examples.zh: 她拍照前在臉上撲了一些粉。

examples.en: Mix the baking powder with flour in a large bowl.
examples.zh: 把泡打粉和麵粉在大碗中混合。

examples.en: The baker powdered the cake with sugar.
examples.zh: 烘焙師傅在蛋糕上撒了糖粉。

examples.en: Mom powdered the baby after his bath.
examples.zh: 媽媽在寶寶洗完澡後幫他撲上爽身粉。

examples.en: The workers powdered the stone to make a fine paint.
examples.zh: 工人們把石頭磨成粉末製成細緻的顏料。

examples.en: Time with family is precious to me.
examples.zh: 與家人相處的時光對我來說很珍貴。

examples.en: She keeps her precious photos in a small wooden box.
examples.zh: 她把珍貴的照片收在一個小木盒裡。

examples.en: Water is a precious resource in dry areas.
examples.zh: 在乾燥的地區，水是珍貴的資源。

examples.en: Our professor gave us a long reading list for the semester.
examples.zh: 我們的教授給了我們一份很長的學期閱讀書單。

examples.en: The professor explained the experiment to the whole class.
examples.zh: 教授向全班說明了這個實驗。

examples.en: She became a professor of history at a famous university.
examples.zh: 她成為一所知名大學的歷史學教授。

examples.en: How do you pronounce this long word?
examples.zh: 你怎麼念這個很長的字？

examples.en: The teacher asked us to pronounce each word slowly.
examples.zh: 老師要我們慢慢念出每個字。

examples.en: The judge pronounced the team the winner of the contest.
examples.zh: 評審宣布該隊為比賽的優勝者。

examples.en: Use the pump to fill the bicycle tire with air.
examples.zh: 用打氣筒幫腳踏車輪胎打氣。

examples.en: The village needs a new water pump.
examples.zh: 這個村莊需要一台新的抽水幫浦。

examples.en: A gas pump is out of order at this station.
examples.zh: 這個加油站有一台加油機故障了。

examples.en: Our hearts pump blood around the body.
examples.zh: 我們的心臟把血液輸送到全身。

examples.en: Can you pump up the basketball for me?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我把籃球打氣嗎？

examples.en: The workers pumped water out of the flooded basement.
examples.zh: 工人把淹水地下室裡的水抽出來。

examples.en: She took her phone and keys out of her purse.
examples.zh: 她從小包裡拿出手機和鑰匙。

examples.en: My mother bought a red leather purse at the department store.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在百貨公司買了一個紅色皮製小包。

examples.en: Someone left a small purse on the bus.
examples.zh: 有人把一個小錢包遺留在公車上。

examples.en: He decided to quit his job and travel around Asia.
examples.zh: 他決定辭掉工作，到亞洲各地旅行。

examples.en: Don't quit when the exercise gets difficult.
examples.zh: 運動變難時不要放棄。

examples.en: My grandfather quit smoking ten years ago.
examples.zh: 我爺爺十年前戒菸了。

examples.en: Draw a rectangle that is twice as long as it is wide.
examples.zh: 畫一個長度是寬度兩倍的長方形。

examples.en: The classroom door is shaped like a rectangle.
examples.zh: 教室的門是長方形的。

examples.en: Find the area of the rectangle on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 請算出學習單上那個長方形的面積。

examples.en: I regret not studying harder for the English test.
examples.zh: 我後悔沒有更用功準備英文考試。

examples.en: We regret to inform you that the flight is canceled.
examples.zh: 我們很遺憾通知您，班機已取消。

examples.en: She did not regret moving to a new city.
examples.zh: 她並不後悔搬到新的城市。

examples.en: He felt deep regret about missing his sister's wedding.
examples.zh: 他對錯過姊姊的婚禮感到深深的遺憾。

examples.en: She has no regrets about the choice she made.
examples.zh: 她對自己所做的選擇毫不後悔。

examples.en: The manager expressed regret for the late delivery.
examples.zh: 經理對延遲送達表示歉意。

examples.en: Please remind me to call the dentist tomorrow.
examples.zh: 請提醒我明天打電話給牙醫。

examples.en: This song reminds me of my elementary school days.
examples.zh: 這首歌讓我想起小學的日子。

examples.en: The sign reminds drivers to slow down near the school.
examples.zh: 這個標誌提醒駕駛人在學校附近放慢速度。

examples.en: The movie is about a man who plans to rob a bank.
examples.zh: 這部電影是關於一個計畫搶銀行的男人。

examples.en: Police say someone robbed the jewelry store last night.
examples.zh: 警方說昨晚有人搶了那間珠寶店。

examples.en: A lack of sleep can rob you of your energy.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足會奪走你的精力。

examples.en: We had to rush to the station to catch the last train.
examples.zh: 我們必須趕去車站搭最後一班火車。

examples.en: Don't rush your answers during the exam.
examples.zh: 考試時不要急著寫答案。

examples.en: The children rushed out of the classroom when the bell rang.
examples.zh: 鈴聲響起時，孩子們衝出了教室。

examples.en: There was a rush of customers before the store closed.
examples.zh: 商店打烊前湧進了一大批顧客。

examples.en: We left early to avoid the morning rush.
examples.zh: 我們提早出門，以避開早上的尖峰時段。

examples.en: I am in a rush, so I can't stay for lunch.
examples.zh: 我很趕時間，所以不能留下來吃午餐。

examples.en: She placed the cup carefully on the saucer.
examples.zh: 她小心地把杯子放在茶碟上。

examples.en: The waiter brought a cup of tea with a small saucer.
examples.zh: 服務生端來一杯附小茶碟的茶。

examples.en: The saucer cracked when it fell off the table.
examples.zh: 茶碟從桌上掉下來時裂開了。

examples.en: Wear a warm scarf because it is cold outside.
examples.zh: 外面很冷，請戴上暖和的圍巾。

examples.en: My grandmother knitted me a blue scarf for winter.
examples.zh: 我奶奶為我織了一條冬天用的藍色圍巾。

examples.en: She tied a silk scarf around her neck.
examples.zh: 她在脖子上繫了一條絲巾。

examples.en: The scientist spent ten years studying the habits of bees.
examples.zh: 這位科學家花了十年研究蜜蜂的習性。

examples.en: My cousin wants to be a scientist when she grows up.
examples.zh: 我表妹長大後想當科學家。

examples.en: Scientists are looking for a new way to clean the ocean.
examples.zh: 科學家正在尋找清理海洋的新方法。

examples.en: The new semester starts in early September.
examples.zh: 新學期在九月初開始。

examples.en: I am taking five classes this semester.
examples.zh: 我這學期修五門課。

examples.en: Our final exams take place at the end of the semester.
examples.zh: 我們的期末考在學期末舉行。

examples.en: We ordered fried shrimp at the seafood restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在海鮮餐廳點了炸蝦。

examples.en: Some people are allergic to shrimp and must avoid eating it.
examples.zh: 有些人對蝦子過敏，必須避免食用。

examples.en: The fishermen caught a basket of shrimp this morning.
examples.zh: 漁夫今天早上捕到了一籃蝦。

examples.en: Please accept my sincere thanks for your help.
examples.zh: 對於你的幫忙，請接受我誠摯的謝意。

examples.en: She gave a sincere apology to her classmates.
examples.zh: 她向同學們誠懇地道歉。

examples.en: He seems sincere, so I believe what he said.
examples.zh: 他看起來很誠懇，所以我相信他說的話。

examples.en: Please put the dirty dishes in the sink.
examples.zh: 請把髒盤子放進水槽。

examples.en: The bathroom sink is leaking again, so please call a plumber.
examples.zh: 浴室的洗手台又在漏水了，請找水電工來。

examples.en: He washed his hands at the kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 他在廚房水槽洗手。

examples.en: The heavy stone sank to the bottom of the pond.
examples.zh: 那顆沉重的石頭沉到池塘底部。

examples.en: The boat began to sink after it hit a rock.
examples.zh: 船撞到岩石後開始下沉。

examples.en: The sun sank slowly behind the mountains.
examples.zh: 太陽慢慢沉到山後。

examples.en: We skate at the ice rink every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每個星期六早上都去溜冰場滑冰。

examples.en: She learned to skate when she was five years old.
examples.zh: 她五歲的時候學會了溜冰。

examples.en: Many teenagers skate in the park after school.
examples.zh: 許多青少年放學後在公園玩滑板。

examples.en: He bought a new pair of ice skates for his birthday.
examples.zh: 他為了生日買了一雙新的溜冰鞋。

examples.en: Please put your skates in the locker before the lesson.
examples.zh: 上課前請把你的溜冰鞋放進置物櫃。

examples.en: A wheel on my skate got stuck in a crack in the road.
examples.zh: 我的溜冰鞋有一個輪子卡在路面的裂縫裡。

examples.en: My family likes to ski in Japan every winter.
examples.zh: 我的家人每年冬天都喜歡去日本滑雪。

examples.en: He learned to ski when he was only four.
examples.zh: 他才四歲就學會了滑雪。

examples.en: Beginners should ski on the easy slope first.
examples.zh: 初學者應該先在簡單的雪道上滑雪。

examples.en: She carried her skis to the top of the hill.
examples.zh: 她把滑雪板扛到山頂。

examples.en: These skis are too long for a child.
examples.zh: 這副滑雪板對小孩來說太長了。

examples.en: Put on your skis and check that the bindings are secure.
examples.zh: 穿上滑雪板，檢查固定器是否牢固。

examples.en: The skillful chef cut the fish in seconds.
examples.zh: 那位熟練的廚師幾秒鐘就把魚切好了。

examples.en: She is a skillful player who rarely loses a match.
examples.zh: 她是一位技巧純熟的選手，很少輸掉比賽。

examples.en: It takes a skillful driver to handle this narrow road.
examples.zh: 要有熟練的駕駛才能開得了這條狹窄的路。

senses.zh: 很瘦的；瘦巴巴的；緊身的

examples.en: The skinny cat sat by the door waiting for food.
examples.zh: 那隻瘦巴巴的貓坐在門邊等食物。

examples.en: He was a skinny boy, but he ran very fast.
examples.zh: 他是個瘦瘦的男孩，但跑得很快。

examples.en: She bought a pair of skinny jeans on sale.
examples.zh: 她在特價時買了一條緊身牛仔褲。

examples.en: The model has a slender figure and long legs.
examples.zh: 那位模特兒身形纖細、雙腿修長。

examples.en: A slender tree bent in the strong wind.
examples.zh: 一棵細長的樹在強風中彎了腰。

examples.en: Our team has only a slender chance of winning the game.
examples.zh: 我們這隊贏得比賽的機會很渺茫。

examples.en: We had spaghetti with tomato sauce for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐吃了番茄醬汁義大利麵。

examples.en: Be careful not to overcook the spaghetti.
examples.zh: 小心不要把義大利麵煮過頭。

examples.en: My brother can eat two plates of spaghetti at once.
examples.zh: 我哥哥一次可以吃兩盤義大利麵。

examples.en: Someone stole my bike from the school gate yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天有人從校門口偷走了我的腳踏車。

examples.en: The young actor stole the show with his funny speech.
examples.zh: 這位年輕演員以風趣的演說搶盡了風頭。

examples.en: She stole a glance at the clock during the exam.
examples.zh: 她在考試時偷瞄了一眼時鐘。

examples.en: At only ten dollars, this jacket is a steal.
examples.zh: 這件外套只要十元，真是太划算了。

examples.en: The tickets were a steal during the sale.
examples.zh: 特價期間這些票非常划算。

examples.en: Our hotel room was a steal for that price.
examples.zh: 以那個價錢來說，我們的飯店房間真是物超所值。

examples.en: Steam rose from the hot cup of tea.
examples.zh: 熱茶杯裡冒出蒸汽。

examples.en: The mirror was covered with steam after my shower.
examples.zh: 我洗完澡後，鏡子蒙上了一層水蒸氣。

examples.en: Old trains used steam to move along the tracks.
examples.zh: 老式火車利用蒸汽沿著軌道前進。

examples.en: Mom likes to steam fish with ginger.
examples.zh: 媽媽喜歡用薑來蒸魚。

examples.en: The soup was steaming when she put it on the table.
examples.zh: 她把湯端上桌時，湯還冒著熱氣。

examples.en: You can steam the vegetables for about five minutes.
examples.zh: 你可以把蔬菜蒸大約五分鐘。

examples.en: I have a pain in my stomach after lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐後胃痛。

examples.en: Don't go swimming on a full stomach.
examples.zh: 吃飽後不要去游泳。

examples.en: The baby fell asleep on her father's stomach.
examples.zh: 小寶寶趴在爸爸的肚子上睡著了。

senses.zh: 暴風雨的；多風暴的；激烈的

examples.en: It was a dark and stormy night on the island.
examples.zh: 那是島上一個漆黑又有暴風雨的夜晚。

examples.en: The ferry was canceled because of the stormy weather.
examples.zh: 因為天氣有暴風雨，渡輪停駛了。

examples.en: Their stormy argument ended when the teacher came in.
examples.zh: 老師一進來，他們激烈的爭論就結束了。

examples.en: Mom is cooking soup on the stove.
examples.zh: 媽媽正在爐子上煮湯。

examples.en: Please turn off the stove before you leave the kitchen.
examples.zh: 離開廚房前請關掉爐火。

examples.en: We bought a gas stove for our new apartment.
examples.zh: 我們為新公寓買了一台瓦斯爐。

examples.en: Can I have a straw for my milk tea?
examples.zh: 我的奶茶可以給我一支吸管嗎？

examples.en: The farmer put some straw in the barn.
examples.zh: 農夫在穀倉裡鋪了一些稻草。

examples.en: She wore a straw hat to the beach.
examples.zh: 她戴著一頂草帽去海灘。

examples.en: A white swan was swimming across the lake.
examples.zh: 一隻白天鵝正游過湖面。

examples.en: The children fed bread to the swan in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們在公園裡餵天鵝吃麵包。

examples.en: The swan protected her babies from the dog.
examples.zh: 天鵝媽媽保護小天鵝不被狗接近。

examples.en: She has a great talent for music.
examples.zh: 她很有音樂天分。

examples.en: The school holds a talent show every December.
examples.zh: 學校每年十二月都會舉辦才藝表演。

examples.en: Our company is looking for young talent.
examples.zh: 我們公司正在尋找年輕的人才。

examples.en: My uncle is very talkative at family dinners.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在家庭聚餐時非常健談。

examples.en: She is shy at school but talkative at home.
examples.zh: 她在學校很害羞，在家卻很愛說話。

examples.en: The talkative driver told us about the city's history.
examples.zh: 那位健談的司機向我們介紹了這座城市的歷史。

examples.en: I peeled a tangerine and shared it with my sister.
examples.zh: 我剝了一顆橘子和妹妹分著吃。

examples.en: These tangerines are sweet and full of juice.
examples.zh: 這些橘子又甜又多汁。

examples.en: We put a tangerine on the table for the holiday.
examples.zh: 我們為了過節，在桌上放了一顆橘子。

examples.en: The fish tank needs cleaning every week.
examples.zh: 魚缸每個星期都需要清洗。

examples.en: Dad filled the gas tank before the long trip.
examples.zh: 爸爸在長途旅行前把油箱加滿了油。

examples.en: A large water tank stands on the roof.
examples.zh: 屋頂上放著一個大水塔。

examples.en: We put up the tent beside the river.
examples.zh: 我們在河邊搭起了帳篷。

examples.en: Four people can sleep in this tent.
examples.zh: 這頂帳篷可以讓四個人睡。

examples.en: It rained all night, but the tent stayed dry.
examples.zh: 雨下了一整晚，但帳篷裡面還是乾的。

examples.en: You did a terrific job on your science project.
examples.zh: 你的自然科學專題做得非常棒。

examples.en: We had a terrific time at the beach.
examples.zh: 我們在海邊玩得非常開心。

examples.en: There was a terrific noise outside the window.
examples.zh: 窗外傳來一陣極大的噪音。

examples.en: The baby sucked her thumb while she slept.
examples.zh: 小寶寶睡覺時吸著她的大拇指。

examples.en: He hurt his thumb while closing the door.
examples.zh: 他關門時弄傷了大拇指。

examples.en: The teacher smiled and raised her thumb at my answer.
examples.zh: 老師笑著對我的答案豎起了大拇指。

examples.en: We climbed to the top of the tower to see the city.
examples.zh: 我們爬到塔頂俯瞰整座城市。

examples.en: The clock tower is the oldest building in town.
examples.zh: 鐘塔是這個小鎮最古老的建築。

examples.en: A tall office tower stands next to the station.
examples.zh: 車站旁邊矗立著一棟高聳的辦公大樓。

examples.en: The mountain towers over the small village.
examples.zh: 這座山高聳在小村莊上方。

examples.en: My brother towers over everyone in his class.
examples.zh: 我弟弟比班上的每個人都高出一大截。

examples.en: Tall buildings tower above the narrow street.
examples.zh: 高樓高聳在狹窄的街道上方。

examples.en: The police traced the call to a public phone.
examples.zh: 警方查出這通電話是從公共電話打的。

examples.en: Students traced the map onto thin paper.
examples.zh: 學生們把地圖描到薄紙上。

examples.en: She traced her family history back four hundred years.
examples.zh: 她把家族歷史追溯到四百年前。

examples.en: There was no trace of the missing cat.
examples.zh: 那隻走失的貓一點蹤跡也沒有。

examples.en: The sauce has a trace of lemon in it.
examples.zh: 這個醬汁裡有一點點檸檬味。

examples.en: The snow left no trace of his footsteps.
examples.zh: 雪地裡沒有留下他的腳印。

examples.en: He plays the trumpet in the school band.
examples.zh: 他在學校樂隊裡吹小號。

examples.en: The sound of the trumpet filled the hall.
examples.zh: 小號的聲音響遍了禮堂。

examples.en: My cousin bought a new trumpet for his birthday.
examples.zh: 我表哥買了一支新小號當作生日禮物。

examples.en: The baby loves to play in the tub.
examples.zh: 小寶寶很愛在浴缸裡玩水。

examples.en: She bought a tub of ice cream for the party.
examples.zh: 她為派對買了一桶冰淇淋。

examples.en: Put the dirty clothes in the plastic tub.
examples.zh: 把髒衣服放進塑膠盆裡。

examples.en: The train passed through a long tunnel.
examples.zh: 火車穿過一條很長的隧道。

examples.en: Cars slow down when they enter the tunnel.
examples.zh: 車子進入隧道時會減速。

examples.en: The workers dug a new tunnel under the river.
examples.zh: 工人在河底挖了一條新的隧道。

examples.en: Workers will tunnel through the mountain next year.
examples.zh: 工人明年將在山中挖一條隧道。

examples.en: The rabbit tunneled under the fence to reach the garden.
examples.zh: 兔子在柵欄底下挖洞穿過，進入花園。

examples.en: They plan to tunnel beneath the bay.
examples.zh: 他們計畫在海灣底下開鑿隧道。

examples.en: Pack enough underwear for the three-day trip.
examples.zh: 為這趟三天的旅行帶足夠的內衣褲。

examples.en: He bought new underwear at the department store.
examples.zh: 他在百貨公司買了新的內褲。

examples.en: Please put your underwear in the laundry basket.
examples.zh: 請把你的內衣褲放進洗衣籃。

examples.en: Every snowflake has a unique shape when you look closely.
examples.zh: 仔細觀察時，每片雪花都有獨特的形狀。

examples.en: This café offers a unique view of the harbor.
examples.zh: 這間咖啡廳能欣賞到海港獨一無二的景色。

examples.en: The panda is unique to this part of China.
examples.zh: 貓熊是中國這個地區特有的動物。

examples.en: He wore a gray vest over his white shirt.
examples.zh: 他在白襯衫外面穿了一件灰色背心。

examples.en: Cyclists should wear a bright vest at night.
examples.zh: 騎自行車的人在夜間應該穿著顯眼的背心。

examples.en: Mom knitted a warm vest for my grandfather.
examples.zh: 媽媽為我爺爺織了一件保暖的背心。

examples.en: Reading books will build your vocabulary and improve your writing.
examples.zh: 閱讀書籍可以增加你的字彙量，並提升寫作能力。

examples.en: Our teacher gives us a vocabulary test every Friday.
examples.zh: 我們老師每個星期五都會給我們字彙測驗。

examples.en: The article uses simple vocabulary that beginners can follow.
examples.zh: 這篇文章用的是初學者也看得懂的簡單詞彙。

examples.en: We play volleyball on the beach every summer.
examples.zh: 我們每年夏天都在沙灘上打排球。

examples.en: The volleyball team won the school championship.
examples.zh: 排球隊贏得了校內冠軍。

examples.en: Can you lend me your volleyball for the game?
examples.zh: 你可以把你的排球借我比賽用嗎？

examples.en: She wears a silver watch on her left wrist.
examples.zh: 她的左手腕上戴著一支銀色手錶。

examples.en: He hurt his wrist while playing basketball.
examples.zh: 他打籃球時弄傷了手腕。

examples.en: The doctor checked my wrist for any broken bones.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查我的手腕有沒有骨折。

examples.en: May God bless you and your family.
examples.zh: 願上帝保佑你和你的家人。

examples.en: The priest blessed the new couple at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 神父在儀式上為這對新人祝福。

examples.en: We are blessed with good friends and a warm home.
examples.zh: 我們有幸擁有好朋友和一個溫暖的家。

examples.en: Dogs can detect smells that people cannot.
examples.zh: 狗能察覺到人類聞不到的氣味。

examples.en: The machine can detect small changes in temperature.
examples.zh: 這台機器可以偵測溫度的細微變化。

examples.en: I detected a note of worry in her voice.
examples.zh: 我從她的聲音中察覺到一絲擔憂。

senses.zh: 精力充沛的；充滿活力的

examples.en: My little brother is always energetic in the morning.
examples.zh: 我弟弟早上總是精力充沛。

examples.en: The coach asked the team to stay energetic until the end.
examples.zh: 教練要求球隊一直到比賽結束都要保持活力。

examples.en: She gave an energetic speech to the new students.
examples.zh: 她對新生發表了一場充滿活力的演講。

examples.en: It was too foggy to see the road.
examples.zh: 霧太濃了，看不清楚路。

examples.en: The flight was delayed because of the foggy weather.
examples.zh: 因為起霧的天氣，班機延誤了。

examples.en: My memory of that day is still foggy.
examples.zh: 我對那天的記憶仍然很模糊。

examples.en: She ran to hug her mother at the airport.
examples.zh: 她在機場跑過去擁抱媽媽。

examples.en: The little girl hugged her teddy bear tightly.
examples.zh: 小女孩緊緊抱著她的泰迪熊。

examples.en: Friends hugged each other after the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 畢業典禮後，朋友們互相擁抱。

examples.en: Give your grandma a big hug when you see her.
examples.zh: 見到奶奶時，給她一個大大的擁抱。

examples.en: A warm hug made him feel better.
examples.zh: 一個溫暖的擁抱讓他覺得好多了。

examples.en: The two sisters shared a long hug at the station.
examples.zh: 兩姊妹在車站相擁了好久。

examples.en: Would you like a slice of cake?
examples.zh: 你想吃一片蛋糕嗎？

examples.en: Put a slice of cheese on the bread.
examples.zh: 在麵包上放一片起司。

examples.en: He ate three slices of watermelon after playing basketball outside.
examples.zh: 他在外面打完籃球後，吃了三片西瓜。

examples.en: Please slice the tomatoes for the salad.
examples.zh: 請把番茄切片做沙拉。

examples.en: Dad sliced the bread with a sharp knife.
examples.zh: 爸爸用一把鋒利的刀把麵包切片。

examples.en: Slice the apple into thin pieces before adding it to the salad.
examples.zh: 先把蘋果切成薄片，再加入沙拉中。

examples.en: Don't yell at your little sister just because she made a mistake.
examples.zh: 不要只因為妹妹犯了錯，就對她大吼大叫。

examples.en: The fans yelled loudly when their team scored.
examples.zh: 球迷在自己的球隊得分時大聲歡呼。

examples.en: He yelled for help when the bus door closed.
examples.zh: 公車門關上時，他大聲呼救。

examples.en: We heard a loud yell from the playground.
examples.zh: 我們聽到操場傳來一聲大喊。

examples.en: She let out a yell of joy when she won.
examples.zh: 她贏了的時候發出一聲歡呼。

examples.en: His yell woke everyone in the house.
examples.zh: 他的叫聲把家裡的每個人都吵醒了。

examples.en: She worked hard to achieve her goal.
examples.zh: 她努力工作來達成自己的目標。

examples.en: Students can achieve better grades with regular practice.
examples.zh: 學生透過規律的練習可以獲得更好的成績。

examples.en: The team achieved great success this year by working closely together.
examples.zh: 這支團隊今年透過密切合作，獲得了很大的成功。

examples.en: Being tall is an advantage in basketball.
examples.zh: 身高高在打籃球時是一種優勢。

examples.en: The new phone has several advantages over the old one.
examples.zh: 這支新手機比舊的有好幾項優點。

examples.en: We took advantage of the sunny weather to go hiking.
examples.zh: 我們趁著天氣晴朗去健行。

examples.en: The children dreamed of an adventure in the jungle.
examples.zh: 孩子們夢想著在叢林裡冒險。

examples.en: Our trip to the island was a real adventure.
examples.zh: 我們的小島之旅真是一場冒險。

examples.en: She loves reading adventure stories before bed.
examples.zh: 她喜歡睡前閱讀冒險故事。

examples.en: Which airline are you flying with to Tokyo?
examples.zh: 你要搭哪一家航空公司的班機去東京？

examples.en: The airline offers cheap tickets in winter.
examples.zh: 這家航空公司在冬天提供便宜的機票。

examples.en: An airline worker helped me find my seat.
examples.zh: 一位航空公司的職員幫我找到座位。

examples.en: The police arrested the driver who ran a red light.
examples.zh: 警方逮捕了闖紅燈的駕駛。

examples.en: Officers arrested two men after the shop was robbed.
examples.zh: 商店遭搶後，警員逮捕了兩名男子。

examples.en: He was arrested for driving without a license.
examples.zh: 他因為無照駕駛而被逮捕。

examples.en: The police made an arrest near the station.
examples.zh: 警方在車站附近逮捕了一名嫌犯。

examples.en: News of the arrest surprised the whole town.
examples.zh: 逮捕的消息讓全鎮的人都很驚訝。

examples.en: The man is under arrest for stealing a car.
examples.zh: 那名男子因偷車而被拘留。

examples.en: The audience clapped after the school play.
examples.zh: 學校的戲劇演出結束後，觀眾都鼓掌。

examples.en: A large audience came to hear the singer.
examples.zh: 很多聽眾前來聽這位歌手演唱。

examples.en: The audience for this magazine is mostly teenagers.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌的讀者大多是青少年。

senses.zh: 知道的；察覺到的；有意識的

examples.en: Are you aware that the shop closes at nine?
examples.zh: 你知道這家店九點關門嗎？

examples.en: She was not aware of the problem until Monday.
examples.zh: 她直到星期一才發現這個問題。

examples.en: Young people should be aware of online safety.
examples.zh: 年輕人應該具備網路安全的意識。

examples.en: The team played badly in the second half.
examples.zh: 這支球隊下半場表現得很糟。

examples.en: I badly need a rest after this long week.
examples.zh: 忙了這麼漫長的一週，我非常需要休息。

examples.en: He badly wanted to join the team after watching the match.
examples.zh: 他看完比賽後，非常想加入那支球隊。

examples.en: My aunt works as a banker in the city center.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在市中心當銀行行員。

examples.en: The banker explained how to open a savings account.
examples.zh: 銀行行員解釋了如何開立儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: He wants to become a banker like his father.
examples.zh: 他想像他爸爸一樣成為銀行從業人員。

examples.en: She began her career as a nurse.
examples.zh: 她以護理師的身分開始了她的職業生涯。

examples.en: Our school offers advice on choosing a career.
examples.zh: 我們學校提供選擇職業的建議。

examples.en: He had a long and happy career in teaching.
examples.zh: 他有一段長久而愉快的教學生涯。

examples.en: We chatted about our weekend plans at lunch.
examples.zh: 我們午餐時聊起了週末的計畫。

examples.en: She likes to chat with her neighbors in the morning.
examples.zh: 她喜歡早上和鄰居聊天。

examples.en: The students chatted online after class about their science project.
examples.zh: 學生們下課後在網路上聊起他們的自然科學專題。

examples.en: I had a long chat with my teacher after class.
examples.zh: 我下課後和老師聊了很久。

examples.en: Let's have a quick chat over coffee.
examples.zh: 我們喝杯咖啡簡短聊一聊吧。

examples.en: There is a chat room on the school website.
examples.zh: 學校網站上有一個聊天室。

examples.en: Every citizen can help keep the city clean by sorting waste.
examples.zh: 每位市民都能藉由垃圾分類來協助維持市容整潔。

examples.en: The mayor thanked the citizens for their help.
examples.zh: 市長感謝市民的協助。

examples.en: She became a citizen of Canada last year.
examples.zh: 她去年成為了加拿大公民。

examples.en: He has a large collection of stamps.
examples.zh: 他有大量的郵票收藏。

examples.en: The museum displayed a new art collection for visitors this week.
examples.zh: 博物館這星期為訪客展出了新的藝術收藏品。

examples.en: Garbage collection takes place every Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 垃圾收集在每個星期二早上進行。

examples.en: Please confirm your seat by e-mail before the concert on Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五的音樂會之前，以電子郵件確認你的座位。

examples.en: The doctor confirmed that she had the flu.
examples.zh: 醫生證實她得了流行性感冒。

examples.en: The hotel will confirm our reservation tomorrow.
examples.zh: 旅館明天會確認我們的訂房。

examples.en: She lives in a small county near the coast.
examples.zh: 她住在海邊附近的一個小縣。

examples.en: The county government built a new library.
examples.zh: 縣政府蓋了一座新的圖書館。

examples.en: Our school is the best in the whole county.
examples.zh: 我們學校是全縣最好的學校。

senses.zh: 民主；民主制度；民主國家

examples.en: Students in Taiwan learn about democracy and voting in school.
examples.zh: 台灣的學生會在學校學習民主制度與投票的相關知識。

examples.en: Free speech is important in a democracy.
examples.zh: 言論自由在民主社會中非常重要。

examples.en: We learned how democracy began in ancient Greece.
examples.zh: 我們學到了民主制度如何在古希臘開始。

examples.en: The class made a democratic decision by voting.
examples.zh: 班上以投票的方式做出民主的決定。

examples.en: Japan is a democratic country with a long history.
examples.zh: 日本是一個有悠久歷史的民主國家。

examples.en: A democratic government listens to its people.
examples.zh: 民主政府會傾聽人民的聲音。

examples.en: Your test score will determine which class you join.
examples.zh: 你的測驗成績將決定你加入哪一個班級。

examples.en: The doctor needs more tests to determine the cause of the pain.
examples.zh: 醫生需要做更多檢查才能查明疼痛的原因。

examples.en: We must determine a date for the school trip soon.
examples.zh: 我們得儘快決定校外教學的日期。

examples.en: The class election will be held on Friday morning.
examples.zh: 班級選舉將在星期五早上舉行。

examples.en: Many people wait in line on election day to vote.
examples.zh: 很多人在選舉日排隊投票。

examples.en: She won the student council election by a large margin.
examples.zh: 她以很大的票數差距贏得學生會選舉。

examples.en: Oxygen is an important element in the air we breathe.
examples.zh: 氧是我們所呼吸的空氣中的重要元素。

examples.en: Teamwork is a key element of a successful project.
examples.zh: 團隊合作是專案成功的關鍵要素。

examples.en: There is an element of truth in what he said.
examples.zh: 他所說的話裡有幾分真實的成分。

examples.en: Taiwan exports many computer parts to other countries.
examples.zh: 台灣把許多電腦零件出口到其他國家。

examples.en: This farm exports fresh fruit to Japan every month.
examples.zh: 這座農場每個月都把新鮮水果出口到日本。

examples.en: The company plans to export its new product next year.
examples.zh: 這家公司計劃明年出口新產品。

examples.en: Tea is an important export of this region.
examples.zh: 茶葉是這個地區重要的出口品。

examples.en: The export of rice was limited last year.
examples.zh: 去年稻米的出口受到限制。

examples.en: Exports rose sharply during the first quarter.
examples.zh: 第一季的出口量大幅成長。

examples.en: Gasoline prices went up again this week.
examples.zh: 這個星期汽油價格又上漲了。

examples.en: My dad stopped at the station to buy gasoline.
examples.zh: 我爸爸在加油站停下來買汽油。

examples.en: Never store gasoline near a heater or an open flame.
examples.zh: 千萬不要把汽油放在暖氣機或明火附近。

examples.en: I visit my hometown during every Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 我每年農曆新年都會回家鄉。

examples.en: Her hometown is a small fishing village in the south.
examples.zh: 她的家鄉是南部的一個小漁村。

examples.en: He misses the food from his hometown.
examples.zh: 他很想念家鄉的食物。

examples.en: Taiwan imports a lot of wheat from other countries.
examples.zh: 台灣從其他國家進口大量小麥。

examples.en: The store imports cheese directly from France.
examples.zh: 這家商店直接從法國進口起司。

examples.en: You need a permit to import some kinds of plants.
examples.zh: 進口某些種類的植物需要許可證。

examples.en: Coffee is a major import in many countries.
examples.zh: 咖啡在許多國家是主要的進口品。

examples.en: The government placed a tax on imports.
examples.zh: 政府對進口品課稅。

examples.en: Imports of electric cars have grown quickly.
examples.zh: 電動車的進口量成長得很快。

examples.en: He missed the game because of a knee injury.
examples.zh: 他因為膝蓋受傷而錯過了比賽。

examples.en: The nurse checked the injury on my arm.
examples.zh: 護士檢查了我手臂上的傷。

examples.en: Wearing a helmet can help prevent head injury.
examples.zh: 戴安全帽有助於預防頭部受傷。

examples.en: The police will investigate the cause of the fire.
examples.zh: 警方將調查火災的原因。

examples.en: Scientists are investigating how bees find flowers.
examples.zh: 科學家正在研究蜜蜂如何找到花。

examples.en: The teacher promised to investigate the missing homework.
examples.zh: 老師答應要調查那份不見的作業。

examples.en: My aunt is a true lover of classical music.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是古典音樂的忠實愛好者。

examples.en: This café is a paradise for book lovers.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡館是愛書人的天堂。

examples.en: The two lovers walked along the beach at sunset.
examples.zh: 這對戀人在日落時沿著海灘散步。

examples.en: We shared a sweet melon after dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐後一起吃了一顆甜甜的瓜。

examples.en: A ripe melon smells sweet at the stem.
examples.zh: 熟透的瓜在蒂頭附近聞起來很香甜。

examples.en: She cut the melon into thin slices for the kids.
examples.zh: 她把瓜切成薄片給孩子們吃。

examples.en: The missing dog was found near the park.
examples.zh: 那隻走失的狗在公園附近被找到了。

examples.en: There is a missing page in this book.
examples.zh: 這本書少了一頁。

examples.en: Please report any missing items to the front desk.
examples.zh: 如有物品遺失，請向櫃檯回報。

examples.en: We hold a monthly meeting on the first Monday.
examples.zh: 我們在每個月的第一個星期一開會。

examples.en: My monthly phone bill is about five hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 我每月的手機費大約是五百元。

examples.en: The gym offers a cheap monthly membership.
examples.zh: 這間健身房提供便宜的月費會員資格。

examples.en: The magazine comes out monthly and includes interviews with local artists.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌每月出刊一次，收錄了當地藝術家的訪談。

examples.en: Our club meets monthly in the library.
examples.zh: 我們社團每月在圖書館聚會一次。

examples.en: Rent is paid monthly, not yearly, under our rental agreement.
examples.zh: 依照我們的租約，租金按月支付，而不是按年。

examples.en: This trip is a great opportunity to practice English.
examples.zh: 這趟旅行是練習英文的絕佳機會。

examples.en: She had the opportunity to meet the mayor.
examples.zh: 她有機會見到市長。

examples.en: Don't miss the opportunity to apply for this job.
examples.zh: 不要錯過應徵這份工作的機會。

examples.en: Our class will organize a farewell party for the teacher.
examples.zh: 我們班要為老師籌辦一場歡送會。

examples.en: She organizes her books by color on the shelf.
examples.zh: 她把書架上的書依顏色整理好。

examples.en: Students should organize their ideas before they write.
examples.zh: 學生寫作前應該先整理好自己的想法。

examples.en: The photographer asked us to stand closer together.
examples.zh: 攝影師請我們靠得更近一點。

examples.en: My uncle works as a wedding photographer.
examples.zh: 我叔叔的工作是婚禮攝影師。

examples.en: A good photographer waits patiently for the right light.
examples.zh: 好的攝影師會耐心等待適當的光線。

examples.en: This company makes a new product every year.
examples.zh: 這家公司每年都推出新產品。

examples.en: The product is sold in many stores across Taiwan.
examples.zh: 這項產品在全台灣許多商店都有販售。

examples.en: The product of six and seven is forty-two.
examples.zh: 六乘以七的乘積是四十二。

examples.en: Sunscreen gives your skin protection from the sun.
examples.zh: 防曬乳能保護你的皮膚不受太陽傷害。

examples.en: The park offers protection to many rare birds.
examples.zh: 這座公園為許多稀有鳥類提供保護。

examples.en: Wear gloves for protection when you clean the kitchen.
examples.zh: 打掃廚房時要戴手套來保護雙手。

examples.en: The scale of the festival surprised many visitors.
examples.zh: 這個慶典的規模讓許多遊客感到驚訝。

examples.en: Please step on the scale to check your weight.
examples.zh: 請站上磅秤量一下你的體重。

examples.en: The map has a scale of one to ten thousand.
examples.zh: 這張地圖的比例尺是一萬分之一。

senses.zh: 攀登；按比例縮放；擴大規模

examples.en: The hikers scaled the steep hill before noon.
examples.zh: 登山客在中午前爬上了陡峭的山丘。

examples.en: You can scale the photo down to fit the page.
examples.zh: 你可以把照片縮小以符合頁面大小。

examples.en: The team plans to scale up its business next year.
examples.zh: 這個團隊打算明年擴大營業規模。

examples.en: Please turn down the volume of the TV.
examples.zh: 請把電視的音量調小一點。

examples.en: This dictionary has two volumes with clear examples for beginners.
examples.zh: 這部字典共有兩冊，提供適合初學者的清楚例句。

examples.en: What is the volume of this water bottle?
examples.zh: 這個水瓶的容積是多少？

examples.en: Every voter in Taiwan must bring an ID card to the polling station.
examples.zh: 台灣的每位選民都必須攜帶身分證到投票所。

examples.en: Young voters care about jobs and the environment.
examples.zh: 年輕選民關心工作和環境。

examples.en: The mayor thanked each voter for coming out.
examples.zh: 市長感謝每一位前來投票的選民。

examples.en: We hiked two hours to see the waterfall.
examples.zh: 我們健行了兩個小時去看那座瀑布。

examples.en: A cool mist rose from the waterfall.
examples.zh: 一陣涼爽的水霧從瀑布升起。

examples.en: The waterfall is the most famous sight in this park.
examples.zh: 這座瀑布是這個公園裡最有名的景點。

examples.en: The museum displays a weapon from ancient times.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了一件古代的武器。

examples.en: Bringing a weapon to school is against the rules.
examples.zh: 把武器帶到學校違反規定。

examples.en: The actor held a plastic weapon in the school play.
examples.zh: 那位演員在學校話劇中拿著一把塑膠武器。

examples.en: We have a weekly quiz every Friday.
examples.zh: 我們每週五都有一次小考。

examples.en: She writes a weekly column for the school paper.
examples.zh: 她為校刊寫每週一次的專欄。

examples.en: The team holds a weekly meeting on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 這個團隊每週一早上開週會。

examples.en: The class meets weekly in the art room.
examples.zh: 這個班級每週在美術教室上課。

examples.en: The newsletter is sent out weekly to all club members.
examples.zh: 這份會訊每週寄給所有社團成員一次。

examples.en: He calls his grandmother weekly to ask about her health.
examples.zh: 他每週打電話給奶奶，關心她的健康。

examples.en: The city plans to widen the road near the school.
examples.zh: 市政府計劃拓寬學校附近的馬路。

examples.en: Reading helps widen your knowledge of the world.
examples.zh: 閱讀有助於擴大你對世界的認識。

examples.en: The river widens as it reaches the sea.
examples.zh: 河流在接近大海時變得越來越寬。

examples.en: We take a yearly trip to the mountains.
examples.zh: 我們每年都會去山上旅行一次。

examples.en: The school holds a yearly sports day in October.
examples.zh: 學校每年十月都會舉辦運動會。

examples.en: His yearly income rose after he changed jobs.
examples.zh: 他換工作後，年收入增加了。

examples.en: The festival is held yearly in our town.
examples.zh: 這個慶典每年都在我們鎮上舉行。

examples.en: You should see a dentist yearly to check your teeth.
examples.zh: 你應該每年看一次牙醫，檢查牙齒。

examples.en: The report is updated yearly to include the latest sales figures.
examples.zh: 這份報告每年更新一次，納入最新的銷售數據。

senses.zh: 在船（車、飛機）上；上船（車、飛機）

examples.en: Welcome aboard! Please find your seat and fasten your seat belt.
examples.zh: 歡迎登機！請找到您的座位，並繫好安全帶。

examples.en: The captain asked everyone to come aboard.
examples.zh: 船長請大家上船。

examples.en: All the passengers were aboard by noon.
examples.zh: 到中午時，所有乘客都已登船。

examples.en: We had lunch aboard the train while traveling to Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 我們搭車前往高雄時，在火車上吃了午餐。

examples.en: Many tourists were aboard the ferry when it left the harbor.
examples.zh: 渡輪離港時，船上有許多遊客。

examples.en: Cell phones must be turned off aboard the plane.
examples.zh: 在飛機上必須關閉手機。

examples.en: Your answer is acceptable, but it could be better.
examples.zh: 你的答案還可以接受，但可以更好。

examples.en: Running in the hallway is not acceptable.
examples.zh: 在走廊上奔跑是不被允許的。

examples.en: The hotel offered an acceptable price for the room.
examples.zh: 這家飯店為房間開出了可接受的價格。

examples.en: The weather report was not very accurate.
examples.zh: 這份天氣預報不太準確。

examples.en: Please give us accurate information about the trip.
examples.zh: 請提供我們有關這趟旅行的正確資訊。

examples.en: This watch keeps accurate time even after years of daily use.
examples.zh: 這支手錶即使每天使用多年，走時仍然很準。

examples.en: I have a bad ache in my back.
examples.zh: 我的背很痠痛。

examples.en: The medicine took away the ache in his tooth.
examples.zh: 這個藥消除了他牙齒的疼痛。

examples.en: She felt an ache in her legs after the long hike.
examples.zh: 走了很長的路之後，她覺得雙腿痠痛。

examples.en: My legs ached after the marathon, so I rested at home.
examples.zh: 跑完馬拉松後，我的雙腿很痛，所以我在家休息。

examples.en: His head ached from the loud noise.
examples.zh: 他的頭因為吵雜的噪音而痛。

examples.en: She ached to see her family again after a year abroad.
examples.zh: 在國外待了一年後，她渴望再次見到家人。

examples.en: Please pay an additional fee for the extra bag.
examples.zh: 多帶的行李請另外付一筆額外費用。

examples.en: The teacher gave us additional time to finish the test.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們額外的時間完成考試。

examples.en: Call us if you need additional information.
examples.zh: 如果你需要更多資訊，請打電話給我們。

examples.en: She takes an advanced math class on Tuesdays.
examples.zh: 她每星期二上進階數學課。

examples.en: This phone uses advanced technology to take clear pictures at night.
examples.zh: 這支手機運用先進科技，在夜間拍出清晰的照片。

examples.en: The advanced course is too hard for beginners.
examples.zh: 這門進階課程對初學者來說太難了。

examples.en: The shop will advertise its sale on the radio.
examples.zh: 這家商店會在廣播中宣傳特賣活動。

examples.en: They advertise their new phone on buses and billboards.
examples.zh: 他們在公車和看板上宣傳他們的新手機。

examples.en: We need to advertise the concert to more students.
examples.zh: 我們需要向更多學生宣傳這場音樂會。

examples.en: My adviser helped me choose a university.
examples.zh: 我的指導老師幫我選擇了大學。

examples.en: The company hired a financial adviser last month.
examples.zh: 這家公司上個月聘請了一位財務顧問。

examples.en: She is an adviser to the school's drama club.
examples.zh: 她是學校戲劇社的指導老師。

examples.en: We cannot afford a new car this year.
examples.zh: 我們今年買不起新車。

examples.en: Can you afford to take a week off work?
examples.zh: 你能請得起一週的假嗎？

examples.en: Many students can't afford expensive textbooks without financial help.
examples.zh: 很多學生若沒有經濟援助，就買不起昂貴的課本。

examples.en: We watched a movie and went home afterward.
examples.zh: 我們看完電影之後就回家了。

examples.en: Afterward, she wrote a thank-you note to her host.
examples.zh: 事後，她寫了一張感謝卡給接待她的人。

examples.en: The meeting ended, and we had tea afterward.
examples.zh: 會議結束後，我們喝了茶。

examples.en: Agriculture is an important industry in this county.
examples.zh: 農業是這個縣的重要產業。

examples.en: Rice farming is a big part of Asian agriculture.
examples.zh: 種稻是亞洲農業的重要部分。

examples.en: She studies agriculture at a national university.
examples.zh: 她在國立大學讀農業。

examples.en: The bakery is in a quiet alley behind the station.
examples.zh: 那家麵包店在車站後面一條安靜的小巷裡。

examples.en: A cat ran down the narrow alley.
examples.zh: 一隻貓沿著狹窄的小巷跑了過去。

examples.en: We found a tiny noodle shop in an old alley.
examples.zh: 我們在一條老巷子裡找到一家小小的麵店。

examples.en: The magician's tricks amaze the children every time.
examples.zh: 魔術師的把戲每次都讓孩子們驚奇不已。

examples.en: It still amazes me how fast she can type.
examples.zh: 她打字的速度之快依然讓我驚嘆。

examples.en: The view from the top of the tower will amaze you.
examples.zh: 塔頂的景色會讓你驚豔。

examples.en: The ambassador gave a speech at the opening event.
examples.zh: 大使在開幕活動上發表了談話。

examples.en: Japan's ambassador to France met the local mayor.
examples.zh: 日本駐法國大使會見了當地市長。

examples.en: The singer became a youth ambassador for the charity.
examples.zh: 這位歌手成為這個慈善機構的青年代表。

examples.en: Her ambition is to become a doctor.
examples.zh: 她的抱負是成為醫生。

examples.en: He has the ambition to start his own company.
examples.zh: 他有創辦自己公司的雄心。

examples.en: Hard work and ambition helped her reach the top.
examples.zh: 努力和抱負幫助她登上頂峰。

examples.en: The principal will announce the winner tomorrow.
examples.zh: 校長明天會公布得獎者。

examples.en: The airline announced a change to the flight time.
examples.zh: 航空公司宣布了航班時間的更動。

examples.en: They announced their wedding date to the family.
examples.zh: 他們向家人宣布了婚期。

examples.en: She felt anxious before the big exam.
examples.zh: 大考前她覺得很焦慮。

examples.en: His parents were anxious when he came home late.
examples.zh: 他很晚回家時，父母很擔心。

examples.en: We are anxious to hear the test results.
examples.zh: 我們急著想知道考試結果。

senses.zh: 無論如何；不管怎樣；隨便地

examples.en: It was raining, but we went to the park anyhow.
examples.zh: 雖然下雨，我們還是去了公園。

examples.en: I'm not sure it will work, but let's try anyhow.
examples.zh: 我不確定行不行，但無論如何還是試試看。

examples.en: Don't just throw your clothes anyhow on the floor.
examples.zh: 不要把衣服隨便亂丟在地上。

examples.en: The two towns are ten kilometers apart.
examples.zh: 這兩個城鎮相距十公里。

examples.en: The old toy fell apart when I picked it up.
examples.zh: 我一拿起那個舊玩具，它就散開了。

examples.en: Stand with your feet apart to keep your balance.
examples.zh: 雙腳分開站立才能保持平衡。

examples.en: The movie has a strong appeal for young viewers.
examples.zh: 這部電影對年輕觀眾很有吸引力。

examples.en: The school made an appeal for old books.
examples.zh: 學校呼籲大家捐贈舊書。

examples.en: The company lost its appeal in court.
examples.zh: 這家公司在法庭上上訴失敗。

examples.en: The mayor appealed to citizens to save water.
examples.zh: 市長呼籲市民節約用水。

examples.en: This kind of music doesn't appeal to me.
examples.zh: 這種音樂對我沒有吸引力。

examples.en: He will appeal the decision next month.
examples.zh: 他下個月將對這項判決提出上訴。

examples.en: The manager approved my request for a day off.
examples.zh: 經理批准了我請一天假的申請。

examples.en: My parents don't approve of staying up late.
examples.zh: 我的父母不贊成熬夜。

examples.en: The city council approved the plan for a new library.
examples.zh: 市議會通過了興建新圖書館的計畫。

examples.en: She put on an apron before she started cooking.
examples.zh: 她開始煮飯前先穿上圍裙。

examples.en: The chef's apron was covered with flour.
examples.zh: 廚師的圍裙沾滿了麵粉。

examples.en: My mother bought a blue apron for me.
examples.zh: 我媽媽買了一件藍色圍裙給我。

examples.en: The campfire turned to ash by morning.
examples.zh: 營火到了早上已變成灰燼。

examples.en: Please sweep the ash off the floor.
examples.zh: 請把地上的灰掃乾淨。

examples.en: A thin layer of ash covered the barbecue grill.
examples.zh: 一層薄薄的灰覆蓋在烤肉架上。

examples.en: He put his phone aside and began to study.
examples.zh: 他把手機放到一旁，開始讀書。

examples.en: Please step aside to let the bus pass.
examples.zh: 請讓到一旁讓公車通過。

examples.en: Joking aside, we really need your help.
examples.zh: 開玩笑先擺一邊，我們真的需要你的幫忙。

examples.en: Volunteers assist the teacher during the school trip.
examples.zh: 志工在校外教學時協助老師。

examples.en: Can you assist me with this heavy box?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我搬這個很重的箱子嗎？

examples.en: A good map can assist you in finding the museum.
examples.zh: 一張好地圖能幫助你找到博物館。

examples.en: The young athlete trains at the stadium every morning.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的運動員每天早上都在體育場訓練。

examples.en: Many athletes from different countries joined the competition.
examples.zh: 許多來自不同國家的運動員參加了比賽。

examples.en: She dreams of becoming a professional athlete one day.
examples.zh: 她夢想有一天成為職業運動員。

examples.en: Her positive attitude makes everyone feel happy.
examples.zh: 她積極的態度讓每個人都覺得開心。

examples.en: The manager is unhappy with his attitude toward work.
examples.zh: 經理對他的工作態度感到不滿。

examples.en: A good attitude is important when you learn a new language.
examples.zh: 學習新語言時，良好的心態很重要。

examples.en: Bright colors attract the attention of small children.
examples.zh: 鮮豔的顏色會吸引小孩子的注意。

examples.en: The night market attracts thousands of visitors each year.
examples.zh: 這個夜市每年吸引數千名遊客。

examples.en: A magnet can attract small pieces of iron.
examples.zh: 磁鐵能吸引小塊的鐵片。

senses.zh: 吸引人的；有魅力的；誘人的

examples.en: The hotel offers an attractive price for students.
examples.zh: 這間旅館為學生提供很誘人的價格。

examples.en: She wore an attractive dress to the school dance.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件很好看的洋裝去參加學校舞會。

examples.en: The city is an attractive place for young workers.
examples.zh: 這座城市對年輕的上班族很有吸引力。

examples.en: The automatic door opens when you walk close to it.
examples.zh: 你走近時，自動門就會打開。

examples.en: My new washing machine has an automatic timer.
examples.zh: 我的新洗衣機有自動定時功能。

examples.en: Blinking is an automatic reaction of the eyes.
examples.zh: 眨眼是眼睛的一種無意識反應。

examples.en: My uncle works for an automobile company in Taichung.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在台中的一家汽車公司工作。

examples.en: The automobile stopped at the red light.
examples.zh: 那輛汽車在紅燈前停了下來。

examples.en: Automobiles are not allowed to enter this old street.
examples.zh: 汽車不准進入這條老街。

examples.en: The hotel is on Fifth Avenue, near the park.
examples.zh: 這間旅館位於第五大道，靠近公園。

examples.en: Tall trees stand on both sides of the avenue.
examples.zh: 大道兩旁都種著高大的樹。

examples.en: Studying abroad is one avenue to better job opportunities.
examples.zh: 出國讀書是通往更好工作機會的一條途徑。

examples.en: The baby was awake at six this morning.
examples.zh: 寶寶今天早上六點就醒著了。

examples.en: I stayed awake all night to finish my report.
examples.zh: 我整晚沒睡，只為了完成報告。

examples.en: Are you still awake, or should I turn off the light?
examples.zh: 你還醒著嗎？還是我該關燈了？

examples.en: I awoke to the sound of rain on the window.
examples.zh: 我在窗上的雨聲中醒來。

examples.en: She awoke early on Saturday and went hiking.
examples.zh: 她週六一早就醒來，去健行了。

examples.en: The loud noise awoke everyone in the building.
examples.zh: 巨大的聲響吵醒了大樓裡的每個人。

examples.en: The alarm clock awakened me at five o'clock.
examples.zh: 鬧鐘在五點把我叫醒了。

examples.en: The documentary awakened her interest in sea animals.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片喚起了她對海洋動物的興趣。

examples.en: Stories about travel awaken a love of adventure in children.
examples.zh: 旅行的故事會喚起孩子們對冒險的熱愛。

examples.en: She received an award for her science project.
examples.zh: 她的科學專題得到了一個獎項。

examples.en: The school gives an award to the best reader each year.
examples.zh: 學校每年都會頒獎給閱讀表現最好的學生。

examples.en: The film won three awards at the festival.
examples.zh: 這部電影在影展中贏得了三個獎項。

examples.en: The principal will award prizes to the winners.
examples.zh: 校長將頒獎品給優勝者。

examples.en: The company awarded him a bonus for his hard work.
examples.zh: 公司因他的努力工作而給他一筆獎金。

examples.en: The judges awarded first place to our team.
examples.zh: 評審把第一名頒給了我們這一隊。

examples.en: The weather was awful during our trip to the mountains.
examples.zh: 我們去山上旅行時天氣糟透了。

examples.en: I have an awful headache this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我今天下午頭痛得很厲害。

examples.en: The soup tasted awful, so I could not finish it.
examples.zh: 這碗湯味道很糟，所以我喝不完。

senses.zh: 尷尬的；笨拙的；不方便的

examples.en: There was an awkward silence after the teacher's question.
examples.zh: 老師提問後出現了一陣尷尬的沉默。

examples.en: He felt awkward when he met his old classmate again.
examples.zh: 他再次遇見老同學時覺得很尷尬。

examples.en: This sofa is too awkward to carry up the stairs.
examples.zh: 這張沙發太笨重不好搬，沒辦法扛上樓梯。

examples.en: The photo has a beautiful mountain in the background.
examples.zh: 這張照片的背景有一座美麗的山。

examples.en: Students from different backgrounds study in our class.
examples.zh: 我們班上有來自不同背景的學生。

examples.en: Please play some quiet music in the background.
examples.zh: 請在背景播放一些輕柔的音樂。

examples.en: My father cooks bacon and eggs for breakfast on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我爸爸星期天早餐會煎培根和蛋。

examples.en: I would like a sandwich with bacon and tomato.
examples.zh: 我想要一份有培根和番茄的三明治。

examples.en: The smell of bacon filled the kitchen.
examples.zh: 培根的香味瀰漫了整個廚房。

examples.en: Washing your hands can remove harmful bacteria.
examples.zh: 洗手可以去除有害的細菌。

examples.en: Some bacteria help us digest food and keep our intestines healthy.
examples.zh: 有些細菌能幫助我們消化食物，維持腸道健康。

examples.en: The students looked at bacteria under a microscope in science class.
examples.zh: 學生們在自然課用顯微鏡觀察細菌。

examples.en: Please pick up your baggage at the airport carousel.
examples.zh: 請到機場的行李轉盤領取你的行李。

examples.en: I paid extra for my heavy baggage.
examples.zh: 我為我的重行李多付了費用。

examples.en: He moved on from the past without any emotional baggage.
examples.zh: 他沒有任何心理包袱，走出了過去。

examples.en: We used worms as bait to catch fish.
examples.zh: 我們用蚯蚓當餌來釣魚。

examples.en: The fish took the bait and swam away.
examples.zh: 魚吃了餌就游走了。

examples.en: The cheap price was just bait to bring customers into the shop.
examples.zh: 那個低價只是把顧客吸引進店裡的誘餌。

examples.en: He baited the hook with a small piece of bread.
examples.zh: 他在魚鉤上裝了一小塊麵包當餌。

examples.en: The store baits shoppers with big discounts on the first day.
examples.zh: 這家店用第一天的大特價來引誘購物的人。

examples.en: Don't bait your little brother into an argument.
examples.zh: 別去激你弟弟跟你吵架。

examples.en: Pandas eat bamboo for most of the day.
examples.zh: 貓熊一整天大部分時間都在吃竹子。

examples.en: This basket is made of bamboo grown near the village.
examples.zh: 這個籃子是用村莊附近種植的竹子做的。

examples.en: A thick bamboo forest grows behind our grandparents' house.
examples.zh: 我們祖父母家後面長著一大片茂密的竹林。

examples.en: The door closed with a loud bang.
examples.zh: 門砰的一聲關上了。

examples.en: We heard a bang from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我們聽到廚房傳來一聲巨響。

examples.en: The fireworks ended with a big bang.
examples.zh: 煙火在一聲巨響中結束。

examples.en: Please don't bang the door when you leave.
examples.zh: 你離開時請不要砰地關門。

examples.en: He banged his knee on the desk.
examples.zh: 他的膝蓋撞到了書桌。

examples.en: The kids banged on the drums with joy.
examples.zh: 孩子們開心地敲著鼓。

senses.zh: 光禿禿的；赤裸的；空蕩蕩的

examples.en: The children ran on the beach in bare feet.
examples.zh: 孩子們光著腳在沙灘上跑。

examples.en: The room was bare except for a bed and a desk.
examples.zh: 房間裡除了一張床和一張書桌，什麼都沒有。

examples.en: The trees are bare in winter after their leaves fall.
examples.zh: 樹葉落下後，樹木在冬天變得光禿禿的。

examples.en: The dog bared its teeth at the stranger.
examples.zh: 那隻狗對陌生人露出牙齒。

examples.en: He bared his feelings in a letter to his mother.
examples.zh: 他在給媽媽的信中坦露了自己的感受。

examples.en: The cold wind bared the branches of the old tree.
examples.zh: 寒風吹落了老樹的葉子，露出光禿禿的枝條。

examples.en: I could barely hear the teacher from the back row.
examples.zh: 我坐在後排，幾乎聽不到老師說話。

examples.en: She barely made it to the station on time.
examples.zh: 她勉強及時趕到車站。

examples.en: We barely know each other, so we do not talk much.
examples.zh: 我們幾乎不認識彼此，所以不太聊天。

examples.en: The farmer keeps hay and tools in the barn.
examples.zh: 農夫把乾草和工具放在穀倉裡。

examples.en: A few cows are sleeping in the barn.
examples.zh: 幾頭牛正在牲口棚裡睡覺。

examples.en: We visited an old red barn on our school trip.
examples.zh: 我們校外教學時參觀了一座紅色的老穀倉。

examples.en: The farmer stored water in a large wooden barrel.
examples.zh: 農夫把水存放在一個大木桶裡。

examples.en: The price of oil is shown per barrel.
examples.zh: 石油的價格是以每桶來標示的。

examples.en: The old barrel was full of apples.
examples.zh: 那個舊桶裡裝滿了蘋果。

examples.en: Many small boats were floating in the bay.
examples.zh: 許多小船漂浮在海灣裡。

examples.en: We had dinner by the bay and watched the sunset.
examples.zh: 我們在海灣邊吃晚餐，看著夕陽。

examples.en: The city is built around a beautiful bay.
examples.zh: 這座城市圍繞著一個美麗的海灣而建。

examples.en: She made a bracelet from colorful beads.
examples.zh: 她用彩色珠子做了一條手環。

examples.en: A bead of sweat ran down his face.
examples.zh: 一滴汗珠從他臉上滑落。

examples.en: The children are sorting beads by color.
examples.zh: 孩子們正在依顏色分類珠子。

examples.en: A beam of light came through the window.
examples.zh: 一道光束從窗戶照了進來。

examples.en: The workers put a steel beam across the roof.
examples.zh: 工人把一根鋼梁架在屋頂上。

examples.en: The little girl had a big beam on her face.
examples.zh: 小女孩臉上綻放著燦爛的笑容。

examples.en: She beamed when she heard the good news.
examples.zh: 她聽到好消息時笑逐顏開。

examples.en: The sun beams down on the beach all day.
examples.zh: 太陽整天照耀著沙灘。

examples.en: The station beams radio signals across the island.
examples.zh: 這個電台向全島發射無線電訊號。

examples.en: The children read a story about a beast in the forest.
examples.zh: 孩子們讀了一則關於森林裡野獸的故事。

examples.en: Many people think the lion is the king of beasts.
examples.zh: 許多人認為獅子是百獸之王。

examples.en: In the movie, the beast turns out to be kind.
examples.zh: 在電影裡，那隻野獸其實很善良。

examples.en: A black beetle crawled across the garden path.
examples.zh: 一隻黑色的甲蟲爬過花園小徑。

examples.en: The boy keeps a beetle in a small glass box.
examples.zh: 男孩把一隻甲蟲養在小玻璃盒裡。

examples.en: There are thousands of kinds of beetles in the world.
examples.zh: 世界上有數千種甲蟲。

examples.en: The cat is sleeping beneath the table.
examples.zh: 貓正在桌子底下睡覺。

examples.en: A small river runs beneath the old bridge.
examples.zh: 一條小河從老橋下流過。

examples.en: She hid the letter beneath a pile of books.
examples.zh: 她把信藏在一疊書下面。

examples.en: The ice looks thick, but the water beneath is deep.
examples.zh: 冰看起來很厚，但下面的水很深。

examples.en: Look at the picture on the wall and the words beneath.
examples.zh: 看看牆上的圖片和下面的文字。

examples.en: We stood on the bridge and watched the river flowing beneath.
examples.zh: 我們站在橋上，看著河水在下方流過。

examples.en: Regular exercise has many health benefits, including a stronger heart.
examples.zh: 規律運動對健康有許多好處，包括讓心臟更強健。

examples.en: The new job comes with good benefits.
examples.zh: 這份新工作有不錯的福利。

examples.en: The concert is held for the benefit of local schools.
examples.zh: 這場音樂會是為了幫助本地學校而舉辦的。

examples.en: Reading every night will benefit your English.
examples.zh: 每晚閱讀對你的英文有益。

examples.en: Many students benefit from the free lunch program.
examples.zh: 許多學生從免費午餐計畫中受益。

examples.en: The new park will benefit the whole neighborhood.
examples.zh: 這座新公園將使整個社區受益。

examples.en: We picked fresh berries at the farm this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天我們在農場摘了新鮮的莓果。

examples.en: She put some berries on top of the yogurt.
examples.zh: 她在優格上放了一些莓果。

examples.en: Birds like to eat the red berries on the tree.
examples.zh: 鳥兒喜歡吃樹上的紅色漿果。

examples.en: I bet you five dollars that he will be late.
examples.zh: 我跟你賭五塊錢，他一定會遲到。

examples.en: I bet she will pass the exam easily.
examples.zh: 我敢說她一定能輕鬆通過考試。

examples.en: They bet on the result of the game.
examples.zh: 他們在比賽結果上打賭。

examples.en: He lost the bet and had to buy lunch.
examples.zh: 他打賭輸了，得請吃午餐。

examples.en: Taking the train is your best bet in rush hour.
examples.zh: 在尖峰時間，搭火車是你最好的選擇。

examples.en: We made a bet about who would win the match.
examples.zh: 我們打賭誰會贏得比賽。

examples.en: The workers bind the boxes with strong rope.
examples.zh: 工人用結實的繩子把箱子捆起來。

examples.en: The contract will bind both companies for two years.
examples.zh: 這份合約將對兩家公司有兩年的約束力。

examples.en: A shared love of music binds the members of the club.
examples.zh: 對音樂的共同熱愛把社團成員聯繫在一起。

examples.en: My finger started to bleed after I cut it.
examples.zh: 我的手指被割到後開始流血。

examples.en: The nurse helped stop the bleeding from his knee.
examples.zh: 護理師幫他的膝蓋止血。

examples.en: Gums can bleed if you do not brush your teeth gently.
examples.zh: 如果刷牙不輕柔，牙齦可能會流血。

examples.en: He wiped his bloody nose with a tissue.
examples.zh: 他用面紙擦拭流血的鼻子。

examples.en: The nurse cleaned the bloody cloth.
examples.zh: 護理師清洗了那塊沾血的布。

examples.en: The doctor told him not to touch the bloody bandage.
examples.zh: 醫生叫他不要碰那條沾血的繃帶。

examples.en: She made a bold decision to study abroad.
examples.zh: 她做了一個出國讀書的大膽決定。

examples.en: The poster uses bold colors to catch your eye.
examples.zh: 這張海報用醒目的色彩吸引你的目光。

examples.en: Write the title in bold letters at the top of the page.
examples.zh: 請把標題用粗體字寫在頁面上方。

examples.en: He wore heavy boots on the hiking trip.
examples.zh: 他在健行時穿了厚重的靴子。

examples.en: Please put the bags in the boot of the car.
examples.zh: 請把袋子放進車子的行李廂。

examples.en: I need a new pair of rain boots for the typhoon season.
examples.zh: 颱風季節到了，我需要一雙新雨靴。

examples.en: The old laptop takes five minutes to boot.
examples.zh: 那台舊筆電要花五分鐘才能開機。

examples.en: Please boot the computer again after the update.
examples.zh: 更新後請重新啟動電腦。

examples.en: My phone fails to boot when the battery is low.
examples.zh: 我的手機電量太低時就無法開機。

examples.en: Long speeches bore most of the students.
examples.zh: 冗長的演講讓大部分學生覺得無聊。

examples.en: I hope this movie will not bore you.
examples.zh: 我希望這部電影不會讓你覺得無聊。

examples.en: The same song on the radio started to bore me.
examples.zh: 收音機裡一直播同一首歌，讓我開始覺得厭煩。

examples.en: The lecture was such a bore that several students fell asleep.
examples.zh: 那場演講無聊得讓好幾位學生都睡著了。

examples.en: He is a bore when he talks about football.
examples.zh: 他一談到足球就讓人覺得很無趣。

examples.en: Cleaning the house every day is a bore.
examples.zh: 每天打掃房子真是件煩人的事。

examples.en: The driver stepped on the brake at the red light.
examples.zh: 司機在紅燈前踩下了煞車。

examples.en: My bike brake does not work well.
examples.zh: 我腳踏車的煞車不太靈。

examples.en: The car stopped quickly because the brakes were new.
examples.zh: 這輛車因為煞車是新的，所以很快就停下來了。

examples.en: The bus driver braked suddenly to avoid a dog.
examples.zh: 公車司機為了閃避一隻狗而突然煞車。

examples.en: You should brake slowly on a wet road.
examples.zh: 在濕滑的路上應該慢慢煞車。

examples.en: She braked hard when the traffic light turned red.
examples.zh: 紅綠燈變紅時，她用力踩了煞車。

examples.en: The door handle is made of brass.
examples.zh: 這個門把是黃銅做的。

examples.en: My brother plays in the school brass band.
examples.zh: 我哥哥參加了學校的銅管樂隊。

examples.en: The old brass bell still rings every morning.
examples.zh: 那只舊黃銅鐘每天早上仍會響起。

examples.en: The firefighter received an award for his bravery.
examples.zh: 那位消防員因他的勇敢而獲頒獎項。

examples.en: It takes bravery to speak in front of the whole school.
examples.zh: 在全校面前說話需要勇氣。

examples.en: The children showed great bravery at the dentist's.
examples.zh: 孩子們在牙醫診所表現得很勇敢。

examples.en: The doctor explained how regular checks can detect breast cancer early.
examples.zh: 醫生解釋定期檢查如何及早發現乳癌。

examples.en: She put her hand on her breast and took a deep breath.
examples.zh: 她把手放在胸前，深深吸了一口氣。

examples.en: I ordered grilled chicken breast with vegetables.
examples.zh: 我點了烤雞胸肉配蔬菜。

examples.en: Take a deep breath before you start your speech.
examples.zh: 開始演講前先深呼吸。

examples.en: He was out of breath after running up the stairs.
examples.zh: 他跑上樓梯後上氣不接下氣。

examples.en: I could see my breath in the cold morning air.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的早晨空氣中，我能看見自己呼出的白氣。

examples.en: Doctors say you should breathe slowly when you feel nervous.
examples.zh: 醫生說緊張時應該慢慢呼吸。

examples.en: It is hard to breathe in this crowded room.
examples.zh: 在這個擁擠的房間裡很難呼吸。

examples.en: Open the window so we can breathe in some fresh air.
examples.zh: 打開窗戶，讓我們吸入一些新鮮空氣。

examples.en: A cool breeze came in through the open window.
examples.zh: 一陣涼爽的微風從敞開的窗戶吹進來。

examples.en: We sat on the beach and enjoyed the sea breeze.
examples.zh: 我們坐在沙灘上享受海風。

examples.en: The math test was a breeze for her.
examples.zh: 數學考試對她來說易如反掌。

examples.en: The bride wore a long white dress at the wedding.
examples.zh: 新娘在婚禮上穿著一件白色的長禮服。

examples.en: Everyone stood up when the bride walked in.
examples.zh: 新娘走進來時，每個人都站了起來。

examples.en: The bride and groom thanked their guests for coming.
examples.zh: 新娘與新郎感謝賓客的光臨。

examples.en: The children blew bubbles in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們在公園裡吹泡泡。

examples.en: There are many bubbles in the soda.
examples.zh: 汽水裡有很多氣泡。

examples.en: A bubble rose slowly to the surface of the water.
examples.zh: 一顆氣泡慢慢浮到水面。

examples.en: The soup began to bubble on the stove.
examples.zh: 湯在爐子上開始冒泡。

examples.en: Water bubbles up from a spring behind the temple.
examples.zh: 水從廟後的泉眼冒出來。

examples.en: The soda bubbled when I opened the bottle.
examples.zh: 我打開瓶子時，汽水冒出了泡泡。

examples.en: The first buds appear on the trees in spring.
examples.zh: 春天樹上開始冒出第一批嫩芽。

examples.en: The rose is still in bud, so it has not opened yet.
examples.zh: 那朵玫瑰還是花苞，所以還沒有盛開。

examples.en: A tiny bud grew at the end of the branch.
examples.zh: 枝條末端長出一個小小的花苞。

examples.en: Our family has a small budget for the trip.
examples.zh: 我們家這趟旅行的預算不多。

examples.en: The school cut the budget for the sports team.
examples.zh: 學校削減了運動校隊的預算。

examples.en: She keeps a monthly budget to save money.
examples.zh: 她訂定每月預算來存錢。

examples.en: You should budget carefully before buying a new phone.
examples.zh: 買新手機前你應該仔細規劃開銷。

examples.en: The company budgeted ten thousand dollars for the event.
examples.zh: 公司為這場活動編列了一萬元的預算。

examples.en: He budgets his allowance so he can save some each week.
examples.zh: 他規劃自己的零用錢，這樣每週都能存一些。

examples.en: We stayed in a budget hotel near the station.
examples.zh: 我們住在車站附近一間經濟實惠的旅館。

examples.en: This budget airline has very low prices.
examples.zh: 這家廉價航空的票價非常低。

examples.en: She bought a budget phone for her grandmother.
examples.zh: 她幫奶奶買了一支平價手機。
